{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28770675/744b863cd090ab7ed8c12b95bf9a76fede48ef3e.png

Greetings, Soldiers!

We’ve discovered an issue affecting Black Squad on Steam. Currently:


 New players or newly created accounts may not see the “Play” or “Add to Library” options in their Steam Library.
 Existing players who remove Black Squad from their library will not be able to re-add it at this time.


Our team is actively working on a fix. Until the problem is resolved, we strongly advise not removing Black Squad from your Steam Library to avoid losing access.

Thank you for your patience and understanding.

Kind regards,

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28770675/9c3d58a7431f815758aa1602b7a34f255c6cceb7.png

Soldiers,

We sincerely apologize for the issue affecting the Battle Pass Spray not working. Our team is actively working on a fix and is committed to resolving it as soon as possible.

We would like to inform you that emergency maintenance is scheduled for April 2. During this time, access to the game will be temporarily unavailable.

Maintenance Schedule:

 KST: 4:00 PM – 5:30 PM (April 2)
 UTC: 7:00 AM – 8:30 AM (April 2)
 CET: 9:00 AM – 10:30 AM (April 2)
 PDT: 12:00 AM – 1:30 AM (April 2)
 SGT: 3:00 PM – 4:30 PM (April 2)
 EDT: 3:00 AM – 4:30 AM (April 2)
 BRT: 4:00 AM – 5:30 AM (April 2)


Duration: 1 hour and 30 minutes

Reward: x1 Gold Weapon Permanent Random Box

Thank you for your patience and support.

- Up to 9 winners per day!

Soldiers,

- x1 Normal Weapon Permanent Random Box

Thank you for your cooperation and support.

notes.title: Update Information on September 5, 2024
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28770675/fc4d04ca79b2fa4fdbf4199b955b5bb349b7dc5c.png

Added new mode "Tactical Shooter"

Mode Guide
▶ Based on the explosion mode, you can acquire points in various battle situations and purchase weapons each round to proceed with battles.
▶ The matches range from 2vs2 to 5vs5, and interference is also allowed.
▶ In the first round, you will be given basic equipment such as a pistol, knife, and 800P.
▶ You can purchase weapons with the 800P you received.
▶ Each round has a preparation phase where you can purchase weapons with points.
▶ You can keep the weapons you purchase until you die, after which only the basic pistol and knife will remain.
** Equipment acquired during battle will be retained even if not purchased.
▶ When the teams are switched, all equipment will disappear and you will be given basic equipment and 800P just like in the first round.

Additional Details:

I. System Overview

1. Planning Intention
- This plan is based on the annihilation mode in most modes, and aims to strategically operate guns by purchasing them using the points that users normally earn in the game based on the explosion mode.

2. Goal
- A new mode that is more meaningful as a team battle
→ The new mode, which focuses on annihilation mode, is based on the explosion mode and is more focused on individual battles that rely on physical strength rather than strategic team battles.

- Utilization of information (points) with low usability in the game
→ Earn points from kills/assists in the game battle screen and use them to purchase weapons using the advancement points from that battle.
- No protective gear or presets available when starting the game
→ You cannot use presets and must purchase equipment using points. You can also purchase and use protective gear.

II. Mode Method
1. Winning Rules
- (Common) Kill all members of the opposing team.

(Exception) (Defense Team) Attacking Tingim C4 can only be installed before winning under this condition.
→ After installation, the installed C4 must be dismantled even if the attacking team is annihilated.

(Simultaneous Annihilation) C4 (not) installed (Common) If both teams are annihilated simultaneously due to grenade exposure, etc., the winner is determined by whether or not C4 is installed.

→ When not installed, the defending team wins, and when installed, the attacking team wins.
- (Attack team) Successfully install C4 and win regardless of whether the attack team is annihilated or not when it activates.
- (Defense team) Successfully dismantled the C4 installed by the attacking team.
- (Defense team) Prevent the attacking team from installing C4 for a limited time.

2. Game Start Rules
- At the start of the game, the player starts with only the default pistol and the default knife.
- 800P is paid when [Game Start] or [Air-Defense Exchange] is performed.

3. Equipment preservation and deletion rules
- If the character survives by winning a round during the round, the equipment will be used in the next round (magazine-related changes to full settings)
→ When purchasing equipment items, delete items that share the preset line you are currently holding.
→ When purchasing equipment items, delete the items you are currently holding.                                            
- When obtaining dropped equipment, the item you were holding is dropped (same as existing rules)
→ When a round ends with dropped equipment, the item is kept, except in cases where the deletion rule applies in subsequent rounds.
- When you die in battle, your equipment will be deleted (except for the default pistol and knife).
→ Delete items that can be purchased from the store        
- When changing the airborne equipment, the equipment and store usage points are deleted (changed to the default equipment status).
→ To adjust the difficulty when changing the airborne.

4. Number of participants
- No level limit, unlike the basic blast mode, minimum number of players is 2vs2 ~ 5vs5 (interception possible)

5. Game usage time
- Changed to 2 minutes and 30 seconds per round, with 40 seconds remaining when C4 is installed    
- Provides a waiting time of 3 seconds when the first round is in progress (including the change of attack and defense).
→ After the first round ends, 15 seconds of purchase time is provided to purchase equipment.
A plan) Only the point store can be used during the waiting time
B plan) The store is available and you can move around during the waiting time, but you cannot leave the respawn area.

notes.title: 3rd Quarter Roadmap - Developer Blogs
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28770675/7e9a604456af7d866e8bc24f5249e089e659c6b0.jpg

Greetings to our Black Squad, Soldiers!

This is the development team leader for Black Squad, we hope you have a great third Quarter ahead.
In this developer roadmap, we want to update you with the following development plans for Black Squad; this roadmap’s purpose is for better communication in order to be inline the players. It will consist of the plans for Q3 of the year.

We hope everyone will take the time to read between the lines in order for you to get an idea of what we envisioned for the game. However, just a reminder that the development plan dates and details are subject to change.

We are also looking forward for your questions and we will surely answer them on the next developer’s roadmap.

Let’s start with this questions as we proceed.

3rd Quarter Plans of 2024:

June Updates

New Game Mode – Weapon Point
Introducing a new game mode perfect for Summer! This mode is designed to challenge your skills as a team player. Whether you're looking to hone your skills or just enjoy a new way to play, this offers a thrilling experience for all players. A point system game mode in which you need to use different kinds of weapons during a match. Make sure to bring along different weapons in your loadout presets for a better chance in obtaining points!
 
Final Season of Super Match
Players who enjoyed and received great rewards from this mode will be truly saddened, every thing has its own end. We will now close the doors for Super Match after 21 seasons. We are thankful for all the players who participated in the Super Matches that were held during the past few seasons!
 
July Updates

New Type of Weapon
With the release of a new weapon during 1st Quarter of 2024, players can expect another weapon to be released this July. For users who enjoy dual wielding type of weapon, this one is perfect for you! Can you guess what it is? Make sure to stay tuned and experience double the firepower!
 
Anniversary of Steam and VFUN Opening
We are excited to announce that the Anniversary of Steam and VFUN is around the corner. We’ve got amazing perks and exciting events waiting in store for players. Participate and gain rewards fit for an anniversary celebration.

Soul Option
Brand new system will be added for newbies and players who are defeated often. This option can improve player abilities or gain buffs pertaining to the player’s health. The options will be available beforing entering a room in order for players to be ready for battle.

August Updates

Weapon Modification System
A new system will be implemented during the last month of this quarter. A whole new system in which you can tweak and modify weapons. Feature that are available for all sorts of players for a fair gameplay.

Summer Festival Event
Get ready to dive into the fun and make the most of this event! With a variety of challenges and activities, there's something for everyone to enjoy. Don't miss out on the chance to collect some of the best rewards we've ever offered. Join us and celebrate the season with a bang!

We hope you’re as excited as we are about these upcoming updates. Our goal is to continuously enhance every player’s gaming experience with fresh content, modes, and features. Please note that details are subject to change. Thank you for your support and dedication to Black Squad. See you on the battlefield!
 
Be keen and alert, Soldiers!

Best regards,
Black Squad Development Team

STEAM FPS FEST

Great news, Soldiers!

Black Squad is featured in the new Steam FPS Fest!

Players can dive into the intense action and captivating gameplay of this beloved first-person shooter. With every pulse-pounding moment, feel your heart race and your senses heightened in the heat of battle.

But wait, there's more! To celebrate this special occasion, we've curated an exclusive event for Steam users to partake in. Join the festivities, collect Fireworks, and revel in the excitement of the FPS Fest!

Don't miss out on the action – dive in now and experience the thrill firsthand!

notes.title: November 23, 2023 Patch Notes and Black & Black Event
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28770675/301bdb797de19918c67b116bc21a66bfa51f5c73.jpg

1. Character Costume Update 

▶ Starting from the maintenance on November 23, 2023, the sale of the 'Character Random Box (Panda & Brown bear)' will be discontinued. 
▶ A new costume option will be introduced for the 'Cheryl B' character. 
  ㆍ This additional costume tuning option is available for characters ranging from Silver to Diamond grades. 
  ㆍThe 'Cheryl B' Diamond-grade character can be obtained through combinations.

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28770675/a061d3e51c8b132a7ef7eedbb8e770e6a77c9746.jpg

Super Match Season 15
- Season Period: After maintenance on November 9th ~ December 7th 05:00 (UTC Time Zone)
- Reward Payout Schedule: During maintenance on December 21st, 2023

Calling all Soldiers! Season 15 has kicked off in style!!

But wait, there's more excitement in store for you. In addition to our in-game rewards, 
we've introduced a remarkable Time Extension Kit Random Box to spice things up. 
Begin your journey today and stand a chance to seize this fantastic new prize!

As for the in-game reward items for the Top 100 Rankers, Sponsors, and Lucky Players, 
they will be distributed just as they were in the previous season.

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28770675/99109e9b28f76666b6621ac3391c8a5d3ecbdb7f.jpg

▶ Super Match 1st Anniversary event will conclude on November 9, 2023.
▶ Black Friday event will commence after maintenance on November 9, 2023.
  ※ Event Period: From November 9, 2023, after maintenance, to December 1, 2023, 23:59 (UTC).

▶ All event missions can be completed until November 30, 2023, 23:59 (UTC).

  ※ Daily missions are missions that reset daily.

1.	Character Costume Update
▶ Sales of 'Character Random Box (Hannah)' will end before maintenance on September 21, 2023.
▶ Sales of 'Carrier Random Box (Elena)' will begin after maintenance on August 24, 2023.
  - Sales Period : September 21, 2023 05:00 (UTC) ~ October 26, 2023 05:00 (UTC)
  ∴ '(Platinum) Elena' appears in the box as a pickup character.
  ∴ The box is most likely to produce 'Elena' during the sales period.
  ∴ If you purchase a certain quantity, you can obtain (Platinum) Elena 100%
▶ A new costume tuning option for 'Elena' is added.
  - Costume tuning options are available from 'Gold' to 'Diamond' grade Characters.
▶ Add combination item
  - (Diamond) Elena is added to the combination acquisition items.

1.	Character Costume Update
▶ Sales of 'Character Random Box (Rachel)' will end before maintenance on August 24, 2023.
▶ Sales of 'Carrier Random Box (Hannah)' will begin after maintenance on August 24, 2023.  - Sales Period : August 24th, 2023 05:00 (UTC) ~ August 21st, 2023 (KST)
  ∴ '(Gold) Hannah' appears in the box as a pickup character.
∴ The box is most likely to produce 'Hannah' during the sales period.
∴ If you purchase a certain quantity, you can obtain (Gold) Hannah 100%
▶ A new costume tuning option for 'Hannah' is added.
- Costume tuning options are available from 'Silver' to 'Platinum' grade Characters.
- Special costume tuning options are available from 'Gold' to 'Platinum' grade Characters.
  ∴ Costume can be opened by consuming the same grade character.

notes.title: Update on June 22, 2023(Notice)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28770675/aec5e54802ed2e9f49f65081b7492f0a7d83f140.jpg

1. Character Costume Update

▶ Before maintenance on June 22nd 2023, sales of ‘Character Random Box(Elena B)’ will be ended.
▶ After maintenance on June 22nd 2023, sales of ‘Character Random Box(Lin)’ will be started.
  - Sales Period : After maintenance on 06.22.2023 ~ before maintenance on 07.06.2023
  - Price : 225 Bullets/Steam 250 Bullets
  ∴ 'Lin (Gold)' appears in the box as a pickup character.
  ∴ Lin is most likely to come out of a box during the sales period. 
▶ New costume option of ‘Lin’ will be added.
  - New costume tuning options are available from Gold to Platinum Grade Character.
∴ Costume can be opened by consuming the same grade character.
∴ ex) Gold Grade Character x2 + TP(C) = Gold Grade Character Costume Open
▶ A new costume tuning option for 'Jayce' is added.
  - The new costume tuning options are available from 'Silver' to 'Platinum' grade character.
  ∴ Costume can be opened by consuming the same grade character.
∴ Ex) Gold Grade Character x2 + TP(C) = Gold Grade Character Costume Open
∴ The Platinum Character can consume TP(C) to obtain the corresponding costume.

notes.title: Item Combination System Guide
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28770675/439c8b410750fce4f19703610e997fd0a8190415.jpg

1. Item combination Update
▶ Item combination system will be added from April 6th 2023.
[The ‘combination’ is available through the button below.]
▶ The combination system is a function that consumes 3 items and acquires 1 new item.
※ Permanent items are used as combination items.
※ The items used in the combination will be destroyed, and you can acquire permanent items.
▶ You can use 'weapon' and 'character' as an item that can be used permanently.
※ Depending on the item, the chance of getting the same type or same weapon as a result increases.
  Ex) When used in a combination of 2 or more AR weapons, the probability of an AR weapon coming out as a result of the combination increases.
Ex) If the weapon does not have a higher grade weapon, the chance of getting all weapons is increased.
※ The combination allows you to increase the rating of characters and weapons.
※ You can increase the probability by consuming EX COPPER or items.
 ‘It is divided into ‘Gold (I, II, III)’ grades.
   ▶ Introduction to items that appear in combination only

notes.title: Development Briefing Notice #3
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28770675/744b863cd090ab7ed8c12b95bf9a76fede48ef3e.png

Hello, this is the Black Squad Development Team.

First of all, we apologize for the urgent initialization of Winner Coin. We apologize again for the insufficient notice and please consider that the Winner Coin will be initialized with the Spring Season open every year.

This development briefing will further explain the improvement of the Juggernaut mode added to the previous patch and the combination system currently under development.
 
Improve Juggernaut mode

It's a new mode with some room for improvement, but are you enjoying it?

The patch on the next 23rd will be improved as follows to suit the purpose of the plan.
1.	Add a Runaway Juggernaut HP bar in the middle of the top.
2.	Add a silhouette for clearer recognition of the Runaway juggernaut.
3.	Walking Runaway Juggernaut -> Change to running (can't attack while running)
If these functions are added, you will be able to feel a different atmosphere, like the Boss Match.
 
Combination System

The results of the combination are being developed as follows: there are random elements while considering the direction the user wants.

1.	The combination requires three items of the same grade. Acquire a higher-grade item or an item of the same grade when it is successful.
2.	In the case of characters, the probability of the characters being consumed is 30% (90% in total) and 10% random.
3.	In the case of weapons, the probability of a series of weapons being consumed is 30% (90% in total) and 10% at random.

We are working hard to develop the first patch in April, so please look forward to it.
 
TP conversion bug
It has been confirmed that the TP conversion bug that has recently occurred occurs when attempting to disassemble and convert items registered in the Steam inventory. In this regard, as a pre-work for the opening of the Steam store in conjunction with the bug fix, the item in the existing Steam inventory was changed to a Black Squad item.

The development team is always listening to the valuable opinions posted by users and will do its best to make the game better.

Thank you very much.

notes.title: Development Briefing Notice #2
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28770675/744b863cd090ab7ed8c12b95bf9a76fede48ef3e.png

Hello, 
This is Black Squad development team. 

In this 2nd Development Briefing, we would like to talk to you about future plans with explanation of item grade that has been changed a lot on last patch. 

About Item Grade
Item grade is classified as below and this method will be applied to items that will be added in the future too.

1. Classified according to type, option value, effect, etc.
2. In the case of weapons, the higher the grade, the better the option and appearance.
3. In the case of characters, the higher the grade, the better options and more character tuning types.

The grade will be linked to the item combination system that will be developed in the future, and there is room for change, but it is under development as follows.

1. Combining a number of lower-grade items to obtain higher-grade items probabilistically
2. The necessary currency is 'EX Copper'. Higher grade and probability increase the consumption.

Future plan
We are currently developing a new mode based on the spring season patch in March. The concept of the new mode is a fight between Crazy Juggernaut and normal users. It is PVP, but we intended to make like Boss Match. We are working hard to develop it to provide new fun, so please look forward to it. 

The development team is always listening to users’ opinions, and we will do our best to make better games. 

Thank you.

notes.title: February 23 Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28770675/7561c6d3c252713eec906c0d5118369cea4f801c.jpg

1. Super Match Improvements
 ▶ Super Match Improvement
  - Existing: 20 minutes of sponsorship / Game start after the end of sponsorship 
- Change: 10 minutes of sponsorship / Game start 5 minutes after the start of sponsorship 
→ However, a 20% pre-fee will be applied to sponsors at the start of the game.
    → The ranking will be counted as the value that the pre-fee is excluded from the sponsorship ranking.
    → The donation will be entered as the value that the pre-fee is excluded from the record.
  - A new sponsorship method will be added.
     (1) Quinella: Two players selected regardless of the order will succeed if they win first and second place.
     (2) Triple Quinella: Three players selected regardless of the order will succeed if they win the first, second and third place.
  - ‘30 seconds’ delay for observing the super match has been applied.

2. Add a new character: Jessica
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28770675/fd741939566048739b31a5514fb431751a6f3add.jpg

3. This month's item update
  ▶ This month's character random box will be on sale.
    - Will be changed to the pick-up character Jessica in the character random box.
 	→ Sales period: After maintenance on February 23, 2023 to before maintenance on March 23, 2023
 	→ Pick-up characters can be obtained from general to gold.
        → If you purchase 90 times (Steam 100 times), you can get a permanent box that can earn bronze ~ gold grades.

Attention Soldiers!!

TAC Reloaded is back!! Time for the Black Squad Highlights of the Week!
Showcase your best plays, most fail, and funny moments.

Wanna get featured too? Send us your Sheeshable moments!

The reward for Submitting a Clip: To be announced

Requirements for clips:
- no longer than 60 seconds
- The video must have at least a resolution of 1280x720
- Please use 30fps or 60fps clips only
- Make sure there is no copyrighted music in the background
- Gameplay-Sound should be audible
- Please do not send us any montages / highlight videos of you. Send us individual clips which meet the above requirements.

Send us your clip on the link below:

notes.content:

1. Item Rating Reorganization
▶ Introduction of item rating system
- Item UI background will be changed according to the item ratings.
- Weapons will be rated 'General', 'Bronze', 'Silver', 'Gold', 'Platinum' and 'Dia'.

- Existing characters will be graded as 'General', 'Bronze', 'Silver', 'Gold', and 'Platinum'.
- Existing character box items will be batch processed.
- Tuning options are adjusted according to the introduction of the character rating system.
  ∴ For characters that have already been tuned, this option is retained.
- The sale of Yui and Owen pickup boxes will end, and [General Character Random Box (Owen)] and [General Character Random Box (Yui)] will be sold.

▶ Reorganization with the introduction of rating system
     - Level up reward box improvement
     - Improved Mission Rewards
     - Reorganization of attendance compensation for new and returning users
     - Store Product Reorganization Update

2. Reorganization of the Troop Dispatch
▶ The reward for the Super Match Play Daily Mission will be changed.
     - Improvement of price and time required for each dispatch destination
     - Change compensation according to price and time required
     - Change Compensation Box and Components

3. Reorganization of Proximity Weapons Balance
▶ The attack range of some proximity weapons' weak attacks is raised.
     - Applicable proximity weapons: BALISONG, SQUALUS, KARAMBIT, CYCLONE KNIFE, PUSH DAGGER 32, SEAL-PUP, XIPHIAS
   ▶ The range of attacks on the river of close-range weapons is generally raised (except for Katana).

notes.title: Super Match and Future Plans
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28770675/744b863cd090ab7ed8c12b95bf9a76fede48ef3e.png

Hello. This is Black Squad Development Team.
As the light of the New Year falls on you, we wish the Black Squad users all the best.

Starting in the new year, we would like to share briefly with users what we are preparing and what intentions are being developed through monthly development briefings. Please give us a lot of feedback through the development team's efforts to strengthen communication with users.

The first briefing was about the Super Match.
Although the Super Match has been held since October 13th, the explanation of the content was insufficient. So, we 'd like to explain briefly about the content.

Description of Super Match and Future Plan
Super Match was originally only for R2, but we changed the planning direction to content that all users can participate in because many users wanted to play together. In addition, in order to strengthen the benefits of top users who continue to enjoy, we will give priority to TOP100 users in the previous season to confirm their participation.

The development directions related to the Super Match during the first half of 2023 are as follows.
1. Introduction of class restrictions so that only reliable users can apply for participation.
2. Reducing the penalty for non-participation and eliminating the burden of application.
3. Continuous strengthening of compensation for users who have played to the end.
4. Introduction of ways to reduce waiting time in waiting rooms.
5. Introducing a way to convert a copper into an EX copper through sponsorship even if there are no participants.
6. Add compensation for sponsorship with EX Copper.
7. Add a sponsorship type with fewer cases than the current one.
8. Abolish Copper ownership restrictions and restrictions on Copper sponsorship

The small feedback left by users on the bulletin board is a great help to us. Although not all opinions can be reflected in the game, we will do our best to actively reflect valuable opinions and make it a better game.
Thank you.

notes.content:

December 22nd 2022 Update (Notice)


1. Competitive Match Season 17 Changes
▶ Depending on the result of the competition, Super Match Ranking Points can be obtained.
▶ Competitive Match will be changed from ‘Demolition - Class’ Mode to ‘Demolition mode.

2. Super Match Improvements
  ▶ Super Match Improvements
    - Super Match will be rescheduled.
     ·Previous: 7,8 minutes apart
     ·Change: 1 hour apart
- Super Match's mode will be limited to Demolition Mode
- Maps used to Super Match will be limited in 10 types as below.
     ·BROOKLYN, DOUBLE WING, RUN AND GUN, CHECKPOINT, SANTORINI, WOLF SPIDER, SABOTAGE, NIGHT TOWN, COLLECTION, PAPER COMPANY
- The number of Super Match's participants will be changed to be flexible from 8 to 6~10. 
    - Abolition of Minor Leases
     ·Super Match Minor League will be abolished.
     ·However, you can earn super match rank points by participating in the competition.
    - Add Other Super Match Features
     ·Sponsor ranking by Super Match will be added.
     ·The function of watching the ongoing Super Match game will be added.
       > If you are included in the 10th place in the sponsorship ranking for each competition, you can use the competition you sponsored.
       > The viewing function is available on the 'Game Status' screen for games in progress.

3. Add Character Tuning Options : Letty, Marie
▶ ‘The new accessories tuning option for the 'Marie' character is added.
    - Two additional accessory options have been added. 
     ·[Necklace] Slot option added. You can attach the [Necklace] when you open it.
     ·[Bag] Slot option added. [Bag] can be fitted when opened.

▶ The 'Marie' character's in-game bonus tuning option is added.
    - The option to reduce the completion time of the dispatch has been added. The completion time is reduced by 1% to 10% when dispatched.

▶ New costume tuning options for the 'Letty' character are added.
    - Two costume options have been added.

notes.title: Razer Gold Maintenance December 14 (UTC + 08:00)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28770675/744b863cd090ab7ed8c12b95bf9a76fede48ef3e.png

Greetings Soldiers,

Good Day!

Razer Gold will be having a maintenance on 14th December 2022 (UTC + 08:00), 4:00 A.M. to 7:00 A.M. (3 hours estimated).
During this period, all Razer Gold and Razer SIlver services will be temporarily unavailable including the following:

- Razer Gold Global & Payment Wall
- Razer Gold InComm Activation
- Razer Gold Reload
- Razer Gold Pin Store
- Razer Gold Rixty
- Razer Gold Wallet
- Razer Gold Direct Top-up

Please be aware of the system maintenance and avoid any purchases made until the service is up again.
We apologize for the inconvenience.

Thank you!

notes.title: Clan War Season 5 Announcement
notes.content:
Clan War Season 5 Announcement

1. Clan War Season 5 Schedule Guide
  ▶ Season 5 of Clan Wars will proceed according to the schedule below.
- Period: November 17, 2022 05:00 ~ December 16, 2022 00:00 (UTC)
    - Reward payment Schedule: December 22, 2022 05:00 (UTC)

▶ Clan War 5 Season Tier Policy Changes
  - The policy of determining the absolute value of the existing points for the clan tier has been abolished.
  - Subsequent clan tiers are determined by relative ranking by points.
   ㆍ PLATINUM Tier: Top 10%
   ㆍ GOLD Tier: Top 30%
   ㆍ SILVER Tier: Top 50%
   ㆍ Below BRONZE Tier
   (However, it is limited to the clan that has achieved the minimum requirement for the clan war tier)

  - Clan War Tier Minimum Requirements: Play Clan War 5 times

▶ Clan War Season 5 rewards will be changed as follows.
- Clan War Rewards Enhanced: Platinum and Gold tier reward weapons will be given as permanent weapons.

notes.title: Apologize for the Auto-Ban System
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28770675/744b863cd090ab7ed8c12b95bf9a76fede48ef3e.png

Hello. This is the Black Squad Development team.

We would like to apologize to you about the Auto ban system, an automatic account ban system. And it was missing from the announcement on 13th October.

We are trying to minimize unfair cases by investigating to ban users manually based on Battle Eye and reports from users. However, so many users are still suffering from cheaters. To solve this problem, we updated an auto-ban system on October 13, a system that proactively responds to unauthorized program users.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused to many users because it was not updated to the update notice. We will do our best not to miss any further notice.

We are continuously monitoring and tuning the system to distinguish unauthorized program users. Due to the first time of system operation, we are also aware that there are banned users who did not use unauthorized programs. However, illegal programs must be prevented. Even if it is a little inconvenient, for users who have been banned, please contact us for the ban release through 1:1 inquiry with the request form below.

[Unban Request form]
- In-Game Nick Name: 

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdz0G7OH0V7DRBb-aX3dTHz7P97Dc6vwJOoqfkZRRT936RLgQ/viewform?usp=pp_url

We apologize once again for the omission on important matters.
And all Black Squad development team members will try to make a better game.

Thank you.

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28770675/2335e307d61ac82aba3c446e211f76f983f80051.jpg

13 October Updates

1. Character Random Box Changed
  ▶ The contents of the character random box are changed.
     - Sales Period: After the maintenance on 13 October ~ Before maintenance on 17 November
     - The target character is changed from [Dmitry] to [Letty].

     What is the target?
     It means the central character that changes every month.
     Target characters are more likely to obtain than other characters in the character random box.

2. New Character Update: [Letty]
▶ A new agent, Letty is added to Character Random Box.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28770675/cb500cab102a23d29745ef708293d8f14f7e7643.png

▶ Character Tuning Options Added: [Letty]
   - An additional gold option has been added. You can get 5% ~ 20% additional gold end of the game.
   - An additional BS Coin option has been added. You can get 1 ~ 15 additional BS Coin end of the game.
   - [Letty] Character’s Accessories Slot option added.
    = The added slot parts: [Left Shoulder], [Right Shoulder], [Necklace], [Bag]
    = You can equip the accessories when opening.

notes.title: In-game Currency Integration Announcement
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28770675/70054683f0072e672edd963cd47ebfb01632c6fd.jpg

In-game Currency Integration Announcement

Hello, this is VALOFE Black Squad development team.

Medals, BS Coins, and tickets have been separated and used. However, since the range of items was limited due to the variety of currencies, we found out that the usage of those currencies has decreased over time.
Therefore, we are planning to proceed with in-game currency integration to increase the convenience of users as well as the usage of various currencies.

Apply Date: 29th September 2022 (will be applied during scheduled maintenance)

1. BS Coin, Medal, and Ticket are integrated into BS Coin
Due to removal of in-game medals and tickets, in-game currencies are integrated into BS Coin according to the following ratios.

▶ 20% of medals are integrated into BS Coin.
ex) When you have 10 medals, 10 X 20% = 2
	The number of medals integrated: 2
  ▶ Current ticket amounts X100 will be integrated into BS Coin
ex) When you have 10 tickets, 10 X 100 = 1000
	The Number of the ticket will be integrated into BS Coin: 1000

2. Random Box Changes
Due to removal of in-game tickets, items available by tickets can be purchased by BS Coin

3. Mission, Attendance check, Level up Rewards Changes
Reward medals for missions, attendance, and level-up rewards will be changed to corresponding amount of BS Coins.

4. Tuning Option Changes
The previous tuning options with the additional medal will be changed to an additional BS Coin option.
※ The previous options will be adjusted as the options will be reorganized..

5. Clan Attendance Rewards
The medal of clan attendance rewards, paid differently by clan level, will be changed to BS coins.

Thank you for your support,
VALOFE Black Squad development team.

notes.title: September 30, 2021 Update
notes.content:
AUTUMN with a New Function

Vote Kick
Vote kick is added against an ally member benefiting the opponent team. Be aware it is not the function to kick opponent team players. Once the targeted player get kicked, the player cannot join the match again.

Only unanimous vote except the player-to-be-kicked result a kick. And some details here
The vote of the player submitting the vote kick counts as a yes.
If there is no feedback in 30 seconds, it will be counted as a no.
A player's leave during a vote is counted as a yes.
Players entering a match during vote cannot vote, nor count.

Vote kick is available at Quick Match, Competitive Match, and Clan Match. 2v2 Demolition is not the mode to use this.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28770675/0d59c29fc07ad06051a08b5ddf247e199edb0827.jpg

SUPPLY RAID
Team mode with max 8 on 8
A team making its team score to reach the designated point first wins.
A player needs to play with limited number of ammunition.
To raise score, there are mainly 2 ways: get opponents’ weapons, or get items from supply boxes to destroy,
Getting items from supply boxes raise team score with ammos, without individual score increase.
Obtaining weapons from enemies increases both individual and team score.
An individual score is limited up to 400. But earned score is contributed to a team score still.
When a player equips a pistol, 1 individual score is obtained every 3 seconds.
When a player equips a SMG or a shotgun, 1 individual score is obtained every 6 seconds. After a player reaches the score to get a LMG, there is no auto score increase.
Destroying a supply box itself does not raise any score.
A weapon to equip is stepping up by the player’s score.
Pistol → SMG, Shotgun → LMG → Assault Rifle
A score to get is affected by the differences between the individual scores. E.g. when a player of higher individual score gets the weapon of the player lower individual score, the player will get smaller score increase.
Just step on items from supply boxes or opponents’ weapons to get them.
Max. bullets of 1 magazine can be supplemented when getting weapons or items.
Getting a dropped weapon will not let the player’s weapon to switch.
Weapons of the player of the same team cannot be obtained.
Players are respawned at random locations including match start place.
Supply boxes are generated at specific locations at maps.

notes.title: Competitive Match Season 9
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28770675/39a1a848ee49e5eecbbc8cc8e6d75e1331158f11.png
BLACK SQUAD COMPETITIVE MATCH – SEASON 9 is near.
Please find this event period, the operation plan & rewards here.

Period
Start: 00:00 UTC, Feb. 25, 2021
End: 23:59 April 21, 2020 (UTC, 8 weeks in total)

MATCHING
This season, duo is back in town. However, the individual skills and tactics are still the top values of Competitive Match, and duo is tentative. Competitive Match may return to solo only anytime.

REWARDS
Experiencing the fun from the serious matches will be rewarded with unique items.
As announced,  the end-tier rewards are universally applied to the seasons throughout 2021.
Additionally, Competitive Shop will be introduced in the future. At Competitive Shop, permanent items will be exchangeable with Winner Token, which can be obtained by end-tier results from Competitive Match season 8. They are under development and the related news will be updated via announcement.

General Information
Completed matches only count for special missions. Surrendered matches will not count up the plays.
The tier rewards can be obtained by the tier at the end of the season, not the highest tier you reached.
Any attempt to dodge MMR Point decrease by inactivity without playing a competitive match may lead a permanent ban. The point shown to the other players is refreshed at the time of a player's log-in. However, the decreases have been queuing for your log-in by system. Also at the end of the event, the decrease will be applied even you do not log in even the decrease is not  shown. Any claim with abusing of the system display will be deemed as an attempt to gain an unfair advantage, and the related account will be penalized.
Leaving a match will lead to an immediate penalty.
If the accumulated number of abandoned matches exceeds a certain number, you will be banned from entering the Competitive Channel and you will no longer be able to participate in Competitive Matches during that season.
If you do not play the game, you will be ejected from the match, and if you are continuously going AFK, you will no longer be able to participate in Competitive Matches during a specific time or entire season.
If you play with disruptive manners such as swearing, or intentionally sabotaging, trolling, or not playing properly that leads to consequential damage on your team while benefiting your enemy, you will no longer be able to participate in Competitive Matches during that season.
When you come across players misbehaving, please report it through in-game report or the Black Squad Support Center

notes.title: Competitive Match Season 8
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28770675/160b5075d375d5397fcdb14789d59ed3b01a3e46.png

From this season of Competitive Match, there are significant operation changes.
Get ready to jump on the new season with the following advice about the differences.

PERIOD
December 3, 2020 ~ January 27, 2021
The period of Competitive Match is shortened to 8 weeks from 12 weeks. It will give you to get the season end result faster and keep you stay focused.

MATCHING
As explained in the glint at the previous notices, our plan is set to position Competitive Match as the individual achievement. Right. Competitive Match is the filed for you to wield your own skills and strategies. Clan Match will take the team play more.
As well, the matching often led you against unwanted opponent teams of big point differences. There have been many criteria for matching: the number of members teaming up, MMR/ELO point, region, ping, and so on. However, teaming up nullified the standards and made search could not guide you enough to the plays with the players of similar MMR/ELO. Moreover, some players exploited the teaming in order to gain unfair advantages. That is one of serious topics what we wanted to solve.
To disable teaming to queue is inevitable and we hope this move will let players enjoy better matchmaking. The previous seasons enabled the plays with friends of big differences in MMR/ELO, but it consequently gave unsatisfying play experiences. Since reconfirmation of what Competitive Match heads for, we clearly state a teaming which bring down matching balance will not be adopted. The best way to team up to play is saved for Clan Match to be taken place regularly in the future.

ENTRANCE LEVEL
The required level has returned to level 30.

POINT DECREASE BY INACTIVITY
Now MMR/ELO point decrease by inactivity will be applied faster.

REWARDS
The current currencies have their own roles for the designated purposes. We found the currencies are misused against the original intention, and they will be reverted to serve their respective goals. As going through the watershed of this season, Medal is back as the rewards for personal achievements, obtainable only from participation of events or promotions. Of course the use of medal will be kept on expanding in near future.
Season end rewards by tier will be notified with another announcement as before. Also, there will a change based on utilities. Higher tier will receive more useful weapons, available till the date of next season reward delivery.
As well, we are planning additional rewards for season end rewards. The details we cannot share the shape it will become yet because it is in progress, but the result of this season will be applied. We will back to update with the announcements for it in the future.

General Information
Completed matches only count for special missions. Surrendered matches will not count up the plays.
The tier rewards can be obtained by the tier at the end of the season, not the highest tier you reached.
Any attempt to dodge MMR Point decrease by inactivity without playing a competitive match may lead a permanent ban. The point shown to the other players is refreshed at the time of a player's log-in. However, the decreases have been queuing for your log-in by system. Also at the end of the event, the decrease will be applied even you do not log in even the decrease is not  shown. Any claim with abusing of the system display will be deemed as an attempt to gain an unfair advantage, and the related account will be penalized.
Leaving a match will lead to an immediate penalty.
If the accumulated number of abandoned matches exceeds a certain number, you will be banned from entering the Competitive Channel and you will no longer be able to participate in Competitive Matches during that season.
If you do not play the game, you will be ejected from the match, and if you are continuously going AFK, you will no longer be able to participate in Competitive Matches during a specific time or entire season.
If you play with disruptive manners such as swearing, or intentionally sabotaging, trolling, or not playing properly that leads to consequential damage on your team while benefiting your enemy, you will no longer be able to participate in Competitive Matches during that season.
When you come across players misbehaving, please report it through in-game report or the Black Squad Support Center

notes.content:
NEW MODE : ARMS RACE
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28770675/f7d27b5c9fc4145a3722c0a27bb6c77c7c381c4a.png
The latest mode arrives at Black Squad.
ARMS RACE provides the ladder to climb up from the equal footing. In the new mode, all joining players will follow the same, fixed weapon set, and challenge to reach the target score.
The weapon of each step will be changed by month. And if a condition is met, brand-new skin of the weapon is available at the match: first reach, first served.

The mode is added to Quick Match.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28770675/375dbf141af356d83a980464198811da0f1aa24c.png

 The goal of this 8v8 match is to reaches 40 kills by a player in a limited time.
 A designated kills will change your equipped weapon. 
 A player can equip only the fixed weapon by the designated order. The other weapons cannot be used nor swap to other primary/secondary/melee weapon or grenades. Also it is not possible to pick up a dropped weapon.
 If the score does not reach 40 and the time expires, the team of a higher weapon step wins.
 If the steps tie, the team of more total kills wins.
 When the win is not decided by the conditions above and the total kills of both team tie at the end of the match, an extra time is given. and there is a kill, the win is decided by 'sudden death/golden goal' rules -  the team of the kill wins.
 The match becomes a draw if there is no kill still and the extra time expires.
 The player reaching each step of a weapon first will use the latest skin version of the weapon in the match. 
 The score shows the most kills by a player of each team, not sum of kills.
 The next weapon and kill count to reach the weapon can be found under the score.
 When you reach the final step of the weapon, it will show the final goal.

notes.title: Black Squad Market Policy Change
notes.content:
Please be advised Black Squad market policy is updated not to sell Black Squad items via Steam Community Market from October 29, 2020 after the scheduled maintenance. 

This modification is to keep Black Squad service sustainable with the key experience  of Black Squad play.

It is the inevitable conclusion to disable the community market. We have reviewed there are any alternative ways, but there is no way to maintain the service compatible with community market under the current market policy. The complete removal of market & trade of Black Squad items is the only option left for us to achieve our ultimate goal to keep you playing Black Squad. That was a tough decision, though, we hope it will keep Black Squad survive and become the ignition of turn over for the future.

The update is scheduled to apply right after the maintenance. An item already on the Steam Community Market will not be affected, but it will turn not marketable once the item is sold, cancelled, or removed. 

- Black Squad team

As of October, our items are no longer participating in the Steam community market. To avoid confusion, Valve and Valofe will cancel all outstanding market listings, since those items are no longer resellable. You can continue to shop for items in-game at any time.

notes.title: Black Squad by Valofe
notes.content:
First, thank you for your playing Black Squad.
We announce Black Squad has now officially been published and developed by Valofe. 
You can keep on playing Black Squad via Steam without any additional process.

The news that NS Studio has commenced the development of Black Squad 2.0 may make you feel uneasy are we aware.
We, Valofe Black Squad team, put the stable & sustainable service as a top priority, and will strive to have Black Squad players to enjoy as you have been playing with the confidence of the perspective of service sustainability.
Both development and publishing of Black Squad will be continued by Valofe. 
Valofe Black Squad team is planning the content update as well as the direction of operation in the future. And you will find the first step by Valofe at the next update, which will be announced soon.

Operation Plan for Competitive Match in SEASON 7 against Unfair ActivityBan against unfair activity for Competitive Match in SEASON 7 will be enforced as below.
Leaving a match will lead to an immediate penalty.
Temporary blocking for suspicious cheating users will begin.
If you repeatedly or intentionally do the following activities, you will receive a temporary or permanent ban from participation in Competitive Matches. 
Leaving a Match
If the accumulated number of abandoned matches exceeds a certain number, you will be banned from entering the Competitive Channel and you will no longer be able to participate in Competitive Matches during that season.
AFK
If you do not play the game, you will be ejected from the match, and if you are continuously going AFK, you will no longer be able to participate in Competitive Matches during a specific time or entire season.
Disruptive manner like insulting & Intentionally Losing a Match
If you play with disruptive manners such as swearing, or intentionally sabotaging, trolling, or not playing properly that leads to consequential damage on your team while benefiting your enemy, you will no longer be able to participate in Competitive Matches during that season. 
Attempt to Dodge MMR Point Decrease
The decrease by not playing a competitive match is refreshed at the time of a player's log-in. So your MMR Point and tier may be shown different from the real MMR Point when you have not played nor logged in. However, the decreases have been queuing for your log-in. Also at the end of the event, the decrease will be applied even you do not log in. Any claim with abusing of the system display will be deemed as an attempt to gain an unfair advantage, and the related account will be penalized.
If you come across players misbehaving, please report it through the Black Squad Support Center

We look forward to your interest and participation in upcoming Competitive Match Season 7.

- Black Squad Team

Operation Plan for Competitive Match in SEASON 6 against Unfair ActivityBan against unfair activity for Competitive Match in SEASON 6 will be enforced as below.
Leaving a match will lead to an immediate penalty.
Temporary blocking for suspicious cheating users will begin.
If you repeatedly or intentionally do the following activities, you will receive a temporary or permanent ban from participation in Competitive Matches. 
Leaving a Match
If the accumulated number of abandoned matches exceeds a certain number, you will be banned from entering the Competitive Channel and you will no longer be able to participate in Competitive Matches during that season.
AFK
If you do not play the game, you will be ejected from the match, and if you are continuously going AFK, you will no longer be able to participate in Competitive Matches during a specific time or entire season.
Disruptive manner like insulting & Intentionally Losing a Match
If you play with disruptive manners such as swearing, or intentionally sabotaging, trolling, or not playing properly that leads to consequential damage on your team while benefiting your enemy, you will no longer be able to participate in Competitive Matches during that season. 
If you come across players misbehaving, please report it through the Black Squad Support Center

notes.title: Ban by breaking rules of conduct including Unfair Activities
notes.content:
It's Black Squad team.

We appreciate your attention on and participation to Clan Versus Event Season 2.
Also we are aware there are inconvenience caused by specific users who try to gain unfair advantages and damage the other players' play experiences (including using unauthorized third party programs, abusing in-game glitches, cheating.)
In case the unfair activities, spreading or sharing the unauthorized third party programs is caught, it may lead the instant actions taken on the player who did without any prior warning or notice according to the rules.
We are monitoring the abnormal game play, and taking actions on the disruptive play which damages competitive game play. Once an individual clan member is found doing unfair activities, it may result in disadvantages to the clan and/or the other clan members.
We look forward to your attention and interest in the Black Squad.

If you come across players' misbehaving, please report it through  Black Squad Support Center with evidences.
Official Black Squad Support Center: https://blacksquadcs.com
We welcome your report and care in order to make fair game play.

Thank you.
- Black Squad Team

Match MakingNotice display when matchmaking search gets expanded / Adjustment of matchmaking standby time for MMR point.
We are aware that there is the inconvenience from matchmaking between a higher MMR point player team and a comparatively lower MMR point player team. And we are trying to find ways to bring better play experience.
From this update, expansion of searching range at both Quick Match and Competitive Match becomes visible for players. Also, MMR point gets more importance for skill-based matchmaking.
The importance of MMR point for matchmaking is adjusted because of the introduction of the new Dragon Tier at the Competitive Match. Also we found the expanded search sometimes faster than intended, so the searching time and range for expanded search is modified.
The adjustment will be monitored by NS Studio after the update. And continuous attention and improvement will be followed in order to check the adjustment works as the purpose and better matchmaking experience. We appreciate your feedback and look forward to having your future ones.

NOTE about Event Rewards
Current Individual / Clan Rank Points will be reset during the scheduled maintenance, and new Clan Ranked Points will be calculated.
Rewards of [EVENT 2] and [EVENT 3] will be sent at the end of the events.
To receive event rewards, players must complete more than 30 matches.
[EVENT 3] rewards are calculated based on the clan you belong to at the end of the event. You must have a record of participating in more than 30 Clan Rank Matches in the same clan.
Examples : 
- 30 plays in A clan, 10 plays in B clan at the end -> No rewards
- 30 plays in A clan, no clan at the end -> No rewards
- 20 plays in A clan, 30 plays in B clan, then back to A clan at the end -> No rewards
- 30 plays in A clan, 30 plays in B clan and stay to the end -> Get rewards


Additional Information
A player above Master Sergeant can enter the Clan Channel.
Players without a Clan or a Mercenary License cannot create or join a match room in the Clan Match server.
Players with Mercenary License can join clan matches.
Players with a Mercenary License, but without a clan, can only earn Individual Rank Points, not Clan Rank Points.
To start a match, the minimum required Clan Members in a team is 3. Teams with only Mercenaries can not start a match.

notes.title: Removing Cheaters from Black Squad
notes.content:
Hello, it's NS Studio,

We are aware there are players using unauthorized programs in order to gain unfair advantage, and inform the results of the measures visible by month as a part of our efforts.

We have always taken the actions to gain unfair advantages seriously. When a player is found to use cheats, hacks, bots, or third party soft wares that provides unfair advantages, which seriously harm the other players' game experience and fun, the user will be permanently banned from the game. The progress or results information of a respective ticket or a report is not publicized. However, we keeps on striving to make level playing field and taking the necessary measures.
As a part of our endeavor and the determination against unfair advantage, we disclose the monthly fluctuation of the imposed bans.
※ The 2019 December bans are being counted, so it is excluded from the graph.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28770675/93915371f7657b08b6c1cf78667098aab37c6de9.png
 
We always keep on seeking the ways to stand against the issues. Detailed opinions are carefully heard, and investigations based on the shared feedbacks are being operated. For your competitive game play, we are working to detect cheats and hacks, and welcome your reports.

We appreciate your feedbacks again, and are waiting for your valuable reports to be submitted with referring the following instructions.
Visit  BLACK SQUAD SUPPORT CENTER
Click 'open new ticket'
Choose 'Hack Report' from category
Describe the detailed information with valid proofs. 

Black Squad Team.

notes.title: Santa Medics! 🎅
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28770675/d23cdb7af14681e130e980230c4e38b6489ea3ac.jpg
Attention Soldiers! With the holidays here we can't help but get into the spirit!
During the week of December 16 - December 20 we have a Discord Giveaway event! 🎁
Every few hours the Black Squad Medics will be giving away various Winter-Theme weapons in Discord!

How to Participate:
A Black Squad Medic will announce the giveaway in a random chat in Discord. (https://discordapp.com/invite/blacksquad)
The first person to ping @CM_XXX with their IGN will receive the item!

It's as simple as that! Here is the schedule shown below:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28770675/c45285197e43deee649b6d060d799639f64c9d88.jpg

*Note:

All Items are 7 Days Duration
Holiday Presents Discord Post sent within a one hour time frame.
Rewards will be sent through in-game mail within 24 hours.
One reward per player

Happy Holidays!

-The Black Squad Medics

[Schedule]

[Changes for SEASON 4]
The division of Competitive Match Solo/Duo and Squad are unified into one Competitive Match.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28770675/0c42cb4e5200dda9ba1cf375d3fe2ad3704f1e4c.png

Competitive Match Unification – Teaming
Competitive Match teams contain 1 to 5 members.
[Note] Competitive Match Season 4 is the first season which unifies Solo/Duo and Squad matches, and players will have 800 MMR points to start rank placement.
[Note] The history of Competitive Match Season 4 will be recorded as one unified summary at your Profile details.
[Note] If the MMR POINT difference between the lowest team member and the highest team member is bigger than 1,000 points, the match cannot start.
[Note] If a user is in the match room and BANNED from competitive matches due to leave penalties, the match cannot start.
Competitive Match – Matchmaking
The unified competitive matches use the same opponent search conditions as before to match players of similar MMR points. 
To search for Group Matches, matchmaking will prioritize finding groups of the same conditions. 
e.g. A team of 4 Grouped players and 1 Solo player will have a higher chance to be matched to an opponent team consisting of 4 Grouped players and 1 Solo player.
After a certain amount of time, the search range will expand to find a group of broader conditions.
e.g. If the search for the team of 4 Grouped players and 1 Solo player is not successful during the designated time, search conditions are widened to find a team of 3~5 Grouped players.
Matchmaking is improved with more subtle condition checks, there is gradual search expansion for teams that have a similar number of grouped players who is also finding a match.
Season 4 initial MMR Point is 800, not affected by the Season 3 result.

notes.content:

Attention Soldiers!

BLACK SQUAD COMPETITIVE MATCH – SEASON 4 will start with the next update.
We would like to introduce the schedule, the operation plan, the events and all of the rewards.

* Some parts of the SEASON 4 end rewards will be updated with an additional announcement. 

SCHEDULE Start: September 30th, 2019 after the update
End: January 6th, 2020 (14 weeks in total)
SEASON 4 OPERATION PLAN The division of the Competitive Match Solo/Duo and Squad will be unified into one Competitive Match.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28770675/0c42cb4e5200dda9ba1cf375d3fe2ad3704f1e4c.png

Competitive Match Unification – Teaming
Competitive Match teams contain 1 to 5 members.
[Note] Competitive Match Season 4 is the first season which unifies Solo/Duo and Squad matches, and players will have 800 MMR points to start rank placement.
[Note] The history of Competitive Match Season 4 will be recorded as one unified summary at your Profile details.
[Note] If the MMR POINT difference between the lowest team member and the highest team member is bigger than 1,000 points, the match cannot start.
[Note] If a user is in the match room and BANNED from competitive matches due to leave penalties, the match cannot start.
Competitive Match – Matchmaking
The unified competitive matches use the same opponent search conditions as before to match players of similar MMR points. 
To search for Group Matches, matchmaking will prioritize finding groups of the same conditions. 
e.g. A team of 4 Grouped players and 1 Solo player will have a higher chance to be matched to an opponent team consisting of 4 Grouped players and 1 Solo player.
After a certain amount of time, the search range will expand to find a group of broader conditions.
e.g. If the search for the team of 4 Grouped players and 1 Solo player is not successful during the designated time, search conditions are widened to find a team of 3~5 Grouped players.
Matchmaking is improved with more subtle condition checks, there is gradual search expansion for teams that have a similar number of grouped players who is also finding a match.
Season 4 initial MMR Point is 800, not affected by the Season 3 result.

Unified Competitive Match can be accessed at the lobby via one icon.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28770675/743bf5d3136cd394882c6a3d9c8a3d8813c08a5b.png

Competitive History for the previous 2 competitive match divisions at your Profile will now show the unified result, previous information of Seasons 1-3 will stay the same.

Relevant information at your Profile will also be arranged for unification according to the change.

Operation Plan for Competitive Match in SEASON 4 against Unfair Activity
Ban against unfair activity for Competitive Match in SEASON 4 will be enforced as below.
Leaving a match will lead to an immediate penalty.
Temporary blocking for suspicious cheating users will begin.
If you repeatedly or intentionally do the following activities in Season 4, you will receive a temporary or permanent ban from participation in Competitive Matches. 
Leaving a Match
If the accumulated number of abandoned matches exceeds a certain number, you will be banned from entering the Competitive Channel and you will no longer be able to participate in Competitive Matches during that season.
AFK
If you do not play the game, you will be ejected from the match, and if you are continuously going AFK, you will no longer be able to participate in Competitive Matches during a specific time or current season.
isruptive manner like insulting & Intentionally Losing a Match
If you play with disruptive manners such as swearing, or intentionally sabotaging, trolling, or not playing properly that leads to consequential damage on your team while benefiting your enemy, you will no longer be able to participate in Competitive Matches during that season. 

If you come across players misbehaving, please report it through the Black Squad Support Center

notes.title: BSCR Update: Official Rules
notes.content:
Attention Soldiers!

These are the Official Rules for the upcoming Black Squad Community Cup Ranks (BSCR). Please make sure to thoroughly read the details here: http://www.blacksquad.com/bscr-rules/

During the season, players can create teams and compete in Community Cups to earn BSCP – (Black Squad Community Points) these Points are tracked on a Leaderboard to determine team ranks. The more Points a Team accumulates, the higher on the Global Rank Leaderboard it will be. The top 10 Teams will be awarded after the end of the Season.

How to Enter Community Cups:
 
Players can find information regarding each Event and the Community Cup Schedules at https://blacksquad.com. The information may also be publicized at various official channels of Black Squad. So make sure to join us on Discord and Facebook!
Current Official Community Cup Organizations are as follows: ASGL, CGO, ESHUB, KATT, MARCOS, EGC, and LSC. They will also provide information regarding schedule on their official media.

How to Register to BSCR:

Team Rules

A Team consists of up to 6 Players.

A Team has to appoint a Team Leader who must register their team and members for BSCR before they can start collecting points for events. Teams that are not officially registered will be unable to play in Community Cups. Make sure to register for BSCR before playing in Cups. 

A Team cannot change or trade its members during a season, teams which change or trade any members during the season will be disqualified from the BSCR. Make sure when signing up for Community Cup Events, that you sign up with the same Team Name and Team members. Information is cross-checked. Do not change Player IGN during this time or you will risk disqualification. 

A Player shall belong to the region where an event is organized.

A Player can only belong to one team during the BSCR.


Team Registration

All Team members must sign up and register at https://partner.neobricks.com/ as a Pro Gamer. These are open registrations and new teams can continually sign up!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/1c0467e47d3e39f21b2f6953a269067c3b0bff41.png

Team Leaders must fill out the following:

IGN:
Event Name: 'BSCR'
Role: Team Leader
Team Name: 
Server Region:

Participating Team members must fill out:

IGN:
Event Name: 'BSCR'
Role: Team Member
Team Name:
Server Region:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/d9d02eecc7acc24ac56bd85861afcf7aab901c64.png

Competition Format:

Mode: 5v5 Demolition
Number of Rounds: Minimum Best of 3, or more, depending on the Community Cup organizer.
Anti-Cheat: MOSS Anti-Cheat must be used for each game by each player. If a Community Cup decides on a different Anti-Cheat to use, an event follows the decision.
Other conditions of competition format (e.g. round time, switching side, brackets, etc) will follow the decision of the Community Cup Organizer for each event.
A Community Cup Organizer and its Staff determine the results of the Event operated by the Community Cup Organizer. Community Cup Organizers reserve the right to make a decision regarding the operation and the challenge or appeal against the event result.


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/37699a1cef8f4c90dc34bb7e2a6e6ec694e3fa6c.jpg

Global Ranking Leaderboard will be updated weekly here: http://www.blacksquad.com/bscr/

Prizes
Prizes will be awarded and paid to the Team Leaders of the Top 10 Teams of the BSCR Leaderboard.

A total of five thousand US dollars ($5,000) in prizes will be awarded according to the following table.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/8111c6b35427af22134ba678e390b3ed1efef247.jpg


Tiebreakers: If two or more Teams on the Leaderboard have the same number of Points, the tie in Top 10 rank will be dealt with the same rank of them.
Example: If there are 3 teams ranked as 5th place with the same points. Then the following rank will stand at 8th place.
The tiebreaker teams will be rewarded with the divided amount of prizes of the sum of the prizes of their ranked places by the number of tiebreaker teams.
Example: There are 4 teams of the same BSCP and they are followed by 8th place, the prize the 4 Teams will be rewarded, is a quarter of the amount of the sum of the 9th place prize and 10th place prize.
BSCR does not grant the $ prize for each event operated by the Community Cup Organizer.
BS Coin Prizes will still be distributed after every Community Cup. BS Coin Prizes have changed to the following:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/f96d4185aecef6bfe052d01ccf7d26fd68430aef.jpg


Penalties

A Community Cup Organizer and the Community Cup Staff determine the result of the Event operated by the Community Cup Organizer. Community Cup Organizers reserve the right to make decisions regarding the operation and the challenge or appeal against the event result. For more information please check here: http://blacksquad.com/bscr-rules/

-Black Squad Team-

notes.title: Introducing BS Community Cup Rank Points & $5,000 Prize Pool
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/6e870a137a30437bede0531ced32d39c3b4dca78.jpg

Attention Soldiers!

Experience fierce competition and exceed your own limitations in Black Squad! To celebrate the 2nd Anniversary of Black Squad, we’d like to announce the BS Community Cup Rankings! Prove yourself as the most passionate player in Black Squad and fight for a prize pool of $5,000!

The Community Cup Ranking Points

If you join an officially appointed community cup, you will be able to collect Community Cup Ranking Points (‘BSCP’). If you place within the Top 4, more points can be earned.
Some ‘premium’ community cups will grant more points.
Ranks and collected BSCP will be announced every week at the official website.


Schedule

Season will operate for 3 months. The first season will take place within the following period.
Period: 28th of July ~ 30th of September
Season will be reset every 3 months. The results and teams by season will be posted on the Black Squad website. 


BSCP Rewards

Total of $5,000 prize pool will be distributed for the first season to the Top 10 teams.
The first place winner will get $2,500! 
All participants will be rewarded with various prizes. 


Community Cup Information

Information about the officially approved community cups can be found on the official Black Squad website and Discord server.
In order to achieve the approval of an official BS community cup, the application form will be provided at the official website.
- Through the review of the requirements, a cup may be approved to qualify.
The officially approved community cups will be notified in a future announcement. 
The details for premium community cups will be updated and posted when the cups and schedules have been decided with thorough consideration and discussion.


More information will be announced step by step about rewards, schedule, and cup application.

Stay tuned!

Black Squad team.

notes.title: Updated Code of Conduct
notes.content:
Attention Soldiers!

We have updated Black Squad's Code of Conduct. Please take note of the following:

Code of Conduct

The Black Squad Team reserves the right to apply sanctions to cases not defined in this list when necessary.


Communication
When participating in communication, you are responsible for how you express yourself. You may not use language that could be offensive or vulgar to others, whether it is provoked or unprovoked.

Hate speech and discriminatory language, such as xenophobic, racist, and sexist speech is inappropriate, as is any obscene or disruptive language.

Threatening or harassing another player is always unacceptable, regardless of the nature of the language used, tone and repetitiveness of the threats or harassment.

Violating any of these expectations will result in a temporary account ban. More serious and repeated violations will result in greater punishments and may result in a permanent ban of your account. 

Naming
Any name the player has the ability to customize — such as Name Tags, or Clan Name — must be appropriate and inoffensive. Any name that violates our standards or disrupts the community will be changed automatically without warning.

It is prohibited to use names that can be used to impersonate a member of the staff, including "GM" "CM" "Mod" and any variation of terms related to the management or staff of the game. Any nickname found or reported containing these terms will be renamed without prior notice.

Cheating
You are responsible for how you and your account are represented in the game. Cheating in any fashion will result in immediate action. Using third-party programs to automate any facet of the game, exploiting bugs, or engaging in any activity that grants an unfair advantage is considered cheating and could lead to a lifetime ban of the account and/or your PC.

Any form of promotion of cheats is considered an offense and will be punished accordingly. According to NS Studio and NeoBricks' decision, hack promotion could also lead to a lifetime ban of the involved accounts.

Exploiting other players is an equally serious offense. Account sharing or selling, win-trading, and anything else that creates an unfair gaming experience for other players will receive harsh penalties such as an account reset or ban. This will be applied to players as well as to clans.

Please note that if your clan is caught cheating in any way, for example using hacks or boosting, your clan may lose all XP, rank points, and become ineligible for all further rewards from events.

In all cases in which an experience deduction is due as part of a punishment, the Medics' criteria will be used based on each particular case.

Behavior
Behavior that intentionally detracts from others' enjoyment such as: AFK, teaming in solo/duo competitive, leaving games in competitive, supporting the enemy, etc. is unacceptable. Excessive occasions will result in a permanent ban of your account.

Discrimination, Racism, Sexism will not be tolerated, excessive behavior will result in a permanent ban of your account.

Acceptable behavior is determined by player reports and the Medics’ decision, and violating these guidelines will result in account restrictions.

Staff
The Medics are the designated staff to enforce this Code of Conduct and Punishment Policy. Any threat, insult, harassment, name shaming, or any other form of attack towards the Medics, or any other Black Squad staff, is forbidden and will lead to penalties according to each case.

If you encounter players violating any of the rules above described, we encourage you to send us a report containing proof such as screenshots or videos here: http://support.blacksquad.com; so we can act against violators as soon as possible.


The Code of Conduct can also be found here: http://blacksquad.com/rules-of-conduct

Let’s play fair and enjoy Black Squad together!

notes.title: Black Squad Ban Waves
notes.content:
Attention Soldiers,

We are aware there are players using unauthorized programs to gain unfair advantage in gameplay which seriously damages the integrity of the game. We always strive to preserve the game experience for our players as well as our game environments. We have been taking serious actions against exploits of hacks and cheats that keep you from enjoying Black Squad. We are working on the issues by the following measures:

-Automatized restriction via Battleye

-Restriction after the review on the tickets sent by our players

-Internal monitoring and restriction

Exploits of unauthorized programs will lead to a permanent ban without any notice, during the last 3 months, approx. 500 accounts have been banned per month.Serious actions have been taken against cheat creators and the technical analysis with implementation. We know your frustration when you are one of the victims of the exploits, in spite of our continuous efforts to provide fair environments. If you face a cheater, a player promoting a hack, or a distributor of unauthorized programs, please submit your report, and we will review with priority. 

Black Squad Official Support Center


 Click 'Open a new ticket'
 http://support.blacksquad.com 
 Click 'Open a new ticket'
 Choose 'Hack report' at topic
 Submit with evidence such as screenshots or video.

Thank you for your patience, and to all of you that have continued to help us by submitting your valuable reports to our team. As a reminder, we suggest to take a look at our previous statement about Hacks in Black Squad Black Squad Hacks: Fact Vs. Myth


-Black Squad Team

notes.title: New Matchmaking system
notes.content:
Attention Soldiers!

We would like to introduce our new servers and the new matchmaking system, so that you can all understand how the new system will enhance your matching experiences.

There was no server merge, there are still the original 5 servers: NA, EU, SA, EA, and SEA. In fact, we added three more servers to EU, NA, and EA so that you can experience better connection! You can recognize these servers as EU2, US2, and EAS2.

The new matchmaking system is based on user environment. Now instead of choosing which server you want to be in, the new system will automatically connect you to the most fitting and optimal Server. Players with the same ping environment will be matched together. This was designed to maintain competitive gameplay. However, if the queue takes too long, the system will expand its search to make your match with players of more differentiated ping levels. This means you can potentially be put in another server to get a game faster, which would therefore result in higher ping.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/5e09f9d24b35cddc0a315c00b001debbcb7e9434.png

In Custom Matches, you will be able to see the various servers on the right hand side. If you click the word 'PING' at the top of the menu, the menu list will rearrange to show the custom rooms with the best ping at the top of the list.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/3a3e6fd5cfcb6bbb7257f42dc9c53d478f52b0a9.gif

Please understand that we want you to enjoy a pleasant gameplay experience and the new matchmaking system is designed to improve just that. There are plans to increase player base which will then shorten matchmaking wait times.

We are aware that some players may be experiencing longer queue times, so we are working on finding a way to shorten these lengths. Thank you for your support and appreciate your understanding.

Thank you always!
- Black Squad Team

notes.title: EA Update 43: PATCH NOTE
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/d2f27e5b9752510e24ea5eb40366403695a2787b.jpg


Matchmaking System based on User Environment

This update introduces a matchmaking system based on user environment, it automatically collects users who have the suitable conditions and will match them them in the most optimal server region.

This system has also been improved to not match players with high ping users who are too different. However, if queues are too long your search range will be extended for faster matchmaking. This might mean you are placed in a different server and may therefore experience higher ping.

In addition, as part of improving the matchmaking environment, new server regions have been added. More may be added or adjusted to provide better service in the future. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/2584f4e4b1bf46ace2d8ee9a8d5463b5215d6e55.png
This update removes the function to select a server region for matchmaking improvement in QUICK MATCH and COMPETITIVE MATCH. Now it will automatically play the game in the best server region based on your connection area.
However, it may match soldiers in your region as well as those in a similar region environment. This will provide a faster matchmaking environment.
Thus, the relevant UI has been redesigned for this.

The Server Region Lists are removed from the Launcher.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/cf8d543201c16cef0520bcd98eee903297eb724e.png

Shortcut Function
Important improvements in this update include the function to add shortcuts to the main lobby so that you can participate more quickly and conveniently in QUICK MATCH and COMPETITIVE MATCH.
If you click the button corresponding to each game mode, you can ignore the intermediate process and proceed directly to room creation, then you can search for the game immediately.
[Note] If you leave the match room, you will be moved to each Channel lobby, not the main lobby.

If a game is not found in QUICK MATCH and COMPETITIVE MATCH CHANNEL in the best server region, the search range will be expanded so that it searches your region as well as similar server regions.
