notes.title: Black Squad Steam Market and Trade Policy Update
notes.content:
Hello Soldiers,

On March 13 we will  update the trade/market policies on Black Squad items via Steam Community Market.

[code]Items: Items obtainable in-game or from DLC 
- Unable to trade or sell via Steam market

Items: Items not obtainable in-game or from DLC
-  Marketable (sellable) via Steam market, not tradable [/code]
 
Example: According to the updated policy, Item A which is currently obtainable in-game is not tradable or sellable in Steam Market. However, once Item A is retired and no longer available in the in-game Shop, Item A will be available to sell or buy (not trade) in the Steam Market.

Please note that all items currently on sale in the Steam Market will follow the above rules after the policy change. 

So please be aware that the change will be applied from March 13 alongside the patch update. Therefore, any items not already in the Steam Market will not change to be included in the future. We appreciate your understanding.

-Black Squad Team

notes.title: Clan Versus Event & new Mercenary System
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/6e2afb652834dfef421114c2ef681d17cff57ed4.jpg

ATTENTION SOLDIERS!

We want to introduce the new Clan Mercenary System. Every soldier will be able to join Clan Ranked Matches for multiple events in the upcoming patch. It will begin on February 20th.

1. Every soldier can join the Clan Channel.

2. Soldiers without a Clan can join the Clan Ranked Matches through buying a Mercenary License. The Mercenary License is available to purchase in the Medal Shop.

3. VIVOX - Voice chat will be enabled for Clan Ranked Matches.

Starting with the new Clan Mercenary System, we planned the following events for Clan Ranked Matches shown below:

CLAN VERSUS EVENT
Event Period: February 20 - March 27
The "Clan Ranked Match" will be added as a Special Mission.

MISSION 1 - Play 10 Clan Ranked Matches
Rewards:
- CLAN VERSUS CARD (PERMANENT)
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/4838d345b2ddf229447891d032c6c04ae0cd67fc.png
- CLAN VERSUS SPRAY (30 DAYS)
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/1b29dd0ba44a98a121377f06f8d0026042389406.png

MISSION 2 - Play 30 Clan Ranked Matches
Reward: K5 VERSUS (PERMANENT)
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/8e3f78fa327692e823411dddd71b6c00db896209.png


EVENT 1 
Individual Rank Points: Top 1 - 100
Rewards:
- 20,000 BS Coins 
- CALLING CARD: CLAN VERSUS RANK POINT TOP 100 (PERMANENT)
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/b2c4b2440a8565149adb8532206f1e0f0a526acb.png

Individual Rank Points: Top 101 - 500
Reward: 5,000 BS Coins

EVENT 2 
Clan Rank Points: Top 1-3
Rewards:
- CLAN SPRAY (180 DAYS)
- CALLING CARD: CLAN VERSUS RANK POINT 1st (PERMANENT)
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/be6110b51a0c043aa4d9835f3d7b028190be2043.png
- CALLING CARD: CLAN VERSUS RANK POINT 2nd (PERMANENT) https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/a34f31793ca66195341bed2acab5560c81a88d72.png
- CALLING CARD: CLAN VERSUS RANK POINT 3rd (PERMANENT)
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/3f617e3096febb6da300646b2d788bd468b7bf5f.png

Clan Rank Points: Top 1- 20
Reward: Clan exclusive emblem ( http://blacksquad.com/emblem )

Clan Rank Points: Top 1- 50
Reward: BALISONG VERSUS (PERMANENT)
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/ecb425f4d65a482c95b27807792fcc29713b1da5.png

Additional Information:

Current Individual / Clan Rank Points will be reset during the scheduled maintenance, and new Clan Ranked Points will be calculated.
Rewards of Event 1 and Event 2 will be sent at the end of the events.
Event 2 rewards are calculated based on the clan you belong to at the end of the event. You must have a record of participating in more than 30 Clan Rank Matches in the same clan.
To receive event rewards, players must complete more than 30 matches.
Players without a Clan or a Mercenary License cannot create or join a match room in the Clan Match server.
Players with a Mercenary License, but without a clan, can only earn Individual Rank Points, not Clan Rank Points.
 To start a match, the minimum required Clan Members in a team is 3. Teams with only Mercenaries can not start a match.


We look forward to your participation in the upcoming Clan Versus event.

Thank you for playing as always,

- The Black Squad Team

Attention Soldiers!


Although 2018 is officially over, we would like to personally close the year by running a Fan Video Contest: The Best of Black Squad 2018!

We've had a wonderful and extremely exciting 2018. Over the year we have built and executed numerous weapons, maps, Competitive Modes, PVE Modes, in-game voice chat, partner program, community cups, ESL Go4Cup, Sommerfest at Gamescom, and much much more. We continue to strive to make the game better in every aspect. Black Squad has truly evolved and we would like to thank you all for the support you have shown throughout. We certainly could not have made all these changes without you! 

So what does The Best of Black Squad 2018 mean to you? Send us a video and show us your best of Black Squad for a chance to win various prizes. We are giving away $450 in Steam Gift Cards and over 200,000 BS Coins!

How to Participate:

1. Upload your videos on our Steam Store VIDEOS page: https://steamcommunity.com/app/550650/videos/
- All participating videos must contain "[UCC]" in the title.
- Submissions will be accepted until 12:00 AM UTC February 10, 2019
2. Videos must be uploaded to YouTube before you submit them on Steam Community.
3. Fill out the following form: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfw_CS97RptScsTIS1Ug8urMDzdf3MwVHcli6LMVpPTg4MNug/viewform
4. 10 Finalists will be decided by the Black Squad Team
5. On February 18, the community votes for the best video through Discord!

Schedule:
Submissions: January 25 - February 10
Finalists Announced and Community Voting Begins: February 18 - February 24

Rules:

1 Entry per Person 
Must be your own unique creation (imitations will be disqualified). Any music used in the videos MUST be either: original, have no copyright issues, or owned by Black Squad.
Family friendly entries only (No NSFW)
10 entries will make it to the finals


Rewards:

10 Finalists:
20,000 BS Coins

1st Place:
$200 Steam Card
50,000 BS Coins

2nd Place:
$150 Steam Card
40,000 BS Coins

3rd Place:
$100 Steam Card
30,000 BS Coins


**NOTE: By entering this Contest you acknowledge and agree to the following terms and conditions. 1. We are collecting your e-mail only to contact winners. 2. We only receive e-mail info for submissions. 3. All of your info will be discarded 7 days after the contest is over. 4. Your submissions may be displayed across various Black Squad platforms 5. If you do not agree to these terms, do not submit your video.


-The Black Squad Team

notes.title: Clan Emblem War
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/f0984d85a2c89b6e8e1d32020e0c1a6100cb1802.jpg

Attention Soldiers!

Today begins the very first day of The Clan Emblem War!! How exciting! 🚩

We are happy to see so many clans participating- however make sure to finish your roster! We have deleted the teams with only 1-2 people. However, we have decided to leave registrations open through the event so that you can continue to add clan mates to your ESHUB roster once you have at least 5 total clan members.

What this means: Make sure to CANCEL or DISPUTE any matches if you come against an opposing team with a player that is NOT part of the same clan.

Clan War Period:
January 17th to February 17th

How to Participate:

1. Go to the website. Click on Black Squad and scroll down to the Ladders.

2. Open your region's ladder.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/044ac0eddcc4772a7023de99837f6870769f85aa.jpg

3. Go to create a match (You can now create a random match)

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/a09527e8b67674b9b9c287b7e8952541580a6d72.jpg

4. Now you have to set up the single details about your upcoming match -
- Create a Match day: You can choose between today/tomorrow
- Hour: set the time you will be ready with your team
- Players in match: 5v5 is mandatory
- Ruleset: Demolition - Games: BO1
- Select players for match (make a hook for your match's roster)

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/5cf7253e188b6078542d473a03f086ef3377957b.jpg

5. Select 'Create Match' on the bottom right.

6. The message 'Your match has been posted successfully' will appear.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/a512d3477f7cd8983a059f44c7549c52f8d79a7d.jpg

7. Your random match has now been created and will be shown under Challenges for every other team of your ladder. Once a team accepts this random match both teams will be able to open the match details page:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/4ee248aa623d2edb2558a5d4c2191eef96b8c9e5.jpg

On the top left  in GREEN you can Cancel a Pending Match or Report the results of a Match. On the top right in RED you can Make a Dispute/ No Show. (Only the team owner/founder and the captains are able to see these buttons)

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/5207c31c1b88a760c5db44304b8032320e5b641d.jpg

8. You can find all your current running matches under your team's profile.

If you have any questions feel free to ask in Discord for quick help. https://discord.gg/EmQnUh3

Good Luck Have Fun!

notes.title: How to fix Error 0xc00007b & Errors with the 64-Bit version
notes.content:
Hello Soldiers,

We recognized that some players have issues with playing Black Squad since the latest Hotfix where we introduced the 64-bit version of the game.

We apologize for any inconveniences caused and want to share some fixes that work for most of players.

ERROR 0xc00007b APPLICATION WAS UNABLE TO START CORRECTLY
You can find detailed instructions on how to fix this error in our FAQ section here: http://support.blacksquad.com/kb/faq.php?id=66
Note: Method 6 fixed the issue for most of them.

ERRORS WITH 64-BIT VERSION
If you get any other error-messages with using the 64-bit Version or you feel like the 64-bit Version is not running smoothly for you, you can still manually start the 32-bit Version of the game.

This can be found in your Black Squad directory in the Steam folder.
For example: " ...\steamapps\common\Black Squad\binaries\win32\"

You need to doubleclick "SteamLauncher.exe" and you should be able to play the game again.

If you experience any other issues, please feel free to contact us through support at http://support.blacksquad.com

- The Black Squad Team

notes.title: Clan Emblem War
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/f0984d85a2c89b6e8e1d32020e0c1a6100cb1802.jpg

Attention Soldiers!

The long awaited Clan Emblem War is finally here! It is time to gather your fellow clan mates and work together to fight for your flag!

Here is a list of Clan Emblems available to be won! http://blacksquad.com/emblem/

To start off the new year we have partnered with The Esports Hub, you and your mates must climb to the top of the Ladder in order to succeed. Skill and Dedication is necessary to earn your clan the coveted Emblem! Ladders are split into regions, and the top 4 Clans of each region will receive a Clan Emblem as well as a special Clan Emblem War Calling Card. If a clan already has an emblem, the next runner up will be chosen. The winning clan with an existing emblem can exchange for a new one. The top 10 clans of each region will also receive 100,000 BS Coins shared among all registered Clan members on ESHUB.

Prizes

Top 4 (per region): Clan Emblem + Clan War Calling Card

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/4a6383f81c1bfd9f40e456e6f3276ba4b1e86a3f.jpg

Top 10 (per region): 100,000 BS Coins shared among registered clan members on ESHUB.

Schedule:

Sign Ups: January 7 -  January 14
Event: January 17 - February 17

Ladder Per Region:

EU Sign Ups

https://www.theesportshub.com/ladder/96

SA Sign Ups

https://www.theesportshub.com/ladder/98

Asia Sign Ups

https://www.theesportshub.com/ladder/97

NA Sign Ups

https://www.theesportshub.com/ladder/99



Exhibition Matches of the Clan Emblem War will be arranged with teams who are interested, these matches will be streamed on Black Squad's Official Twitch: twitch.tv/blacksquadonline

HOW TO PARTICIPATE:

All Players who are interested must create an account on ESHUB: https://www.theesportshub.com/platform/black-squad/pc-blacksquad

Make sure your ESHUB account name is the same as your in-game name.

All players must join ESHUB's Black Squad Discord: https://discord.gg/reeav4K

The Clan Leader must then create the Team on ESHUB and add your clan members accordingly. Only members on your roster will be allowed to participate in the event. Make sure to name your ESHUB Team the same as your Clan name. You have until January 11th to add your clan members. The roster will be checked. Adding any players outside of your clan is forbidden and your clan may be disqualified.

Starting January 17th, the games will begin! The event will end February 17th.

If your are interested in taking part of the Exhibition Matches, please contact the ESHUB Admin to schedule a time.


RULES:

No Ringers- Any teams caught with players who are not in the same clan and not part of the Team Roster will be disqualified. 

Moss is required. If one of your matches gets disputed, you will have to submit the entire team's Moss file in Discord's Moss Channel. Failure to submit will result in a forfeit of the match. You have 5 minutes within completion of a match to report a dispute.

Submit here: https://discord.gg/reeav4K

Teams get 24 hours to dispute a match.

You must play in your own region. There is a Ping Limit difference of 100, teams must play within 100 ping of each other. The teams can agree to cancel the match beforehand if they do not meet requirements.

You can find the detailed rules by clicking on the rules tab of your ladder page: https://www.theesportshub.com/ladder/96


Good Luck, and may the best Clan win! 

-Black Squad Team

COMPETITIVE MODE
A new system has been added, which automatically reduces the MMR POINT(s) for soldiers who don’t participate in Competitive Solo/Duo or SQUAD for a long time.

The operation policy and rules are as below.

 If you do not participate in the Competitive Match for 72 hours, the system will operate and reduce the MMR POINT(s) immediately.
 MMR POINT(s) will be reduced every 24 hours thereafter.
The MMR POINT(s) will be reduced as shown below:

Soldier with more than 1,551 points: 30 points reduction
Soldier with more than 1,151 points: 15 points reduction
Soldier with less than 1,150 points: Not applicable to the system.

 This system does not reduce the MMR POINT(s) below 1,150 points.
 The system works separately for SOLO/DUO and SQUAD.


If you leave the match even during the map loading or waiting for network synchronization before the match starts, you will get the leaving penalty. If you do not want to get the penalty, you must return to the match and complete the match normally.

 For soldiers who leave the match frequently, the ban duration penalty in Competitive Match will be higher.

 At the end of Competitive Match Season 1, the rewards will be given out based on the final MMR POINT(s). Therefore, it is recommended for soldiers to play as regular as possible, since this system may reduce the final MMR POINT at the end of Season 1.

North America - West (TEST)
A new test server is added to check the connectivity in North America – West.

The test will be processed for a certain period of time.
We kindly ask for your participation so that we can get as much test information as much as possible.
During the test period, you can only participate in Custom Match and PVE-EVENT channel.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/373829a1c1812d6122f2e13fadf2b35c9aa71ba2.png


COMPETITIVE MODE VOICE CHAT

VOICE CHAT is now available to use in Competitive Match.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/2b7bb4b5c74df1fbbe98675af3d8e3a05658cbed.png

In order to use VOICE CHAT, please go to 'SETTINGS - SOUND - Voice Channel - Connect/Disconnect'.
The default settings of ‘Voice Channel’ is OFF.
The setting will save from the last change.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/1c051955ae1711fc3ea929a6acfb4c646e5da4f2.png

There are two ways of using VOICE CHAT.

ALL THE TIME: (Always On)
PUSH TO TALK: The shortcut key is the 'O' key.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/18c815e174446a646aae41c50638c31fd233d56f.png


You can adjust the volume level as shown below.

INPUT VOLUME (Speaking Voice- MIC): 1 - 20
OUTPUT VOLUME (Listening to Voice - Speaker): 1 - 20


If you join the competitive match with the feature turned on, the VOICE CHAT function will automatically activate.

VOICE CHAT is only possible between team members.
Competitive Match - You can adjust the option of MIC & Speaker for you and your team members.
For you - Check(ON/OFF) or Adjust 'Output Volume' in Sound Settings
For team members - Check(ON/OFF) or Adjust 'Input Volume' in Sound Settings
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/3c4636fe37c8fcae585879b8682071c36448cbe1.png


To see who is using VOICE CHAT during the match, the callsign of whom is using VOICE CHAT will display below the top left mini map. It will not display when the soldier does not use VOICE CHAT.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/5f50ecfd2b51d28b47554eca09c09516ca379cfe.png

When the match ends and you move to the lobby, the VOICE CHAT automatically ends.


2018 WINTER EVENT

2018 WINTER EVENT STARTS NOW!

SPECIAL MISSION ADDED DURING THE 2018 WINTER EVENT PERIOD (CAN BE ACHIEVED ONLY ONCE)

‘SNOW CRYSTAL CARD/Permanent’ can be earned when you achieve 500 minutes of play time.
[Note] This Special Mission will be removed when the 2018 WINTER EVENT ends.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/5991664f582ec18b3218d2533c0150ceb039372a.png


ATTENDANCE CHECK REWARD UP.

‘SEASON’S GREETING BOX’ + HAPPY HOLIDAY + 50% DOUBLE UP BOOSTER & One Day Item' can be earned each day for the ATTENDANCE CHECK REWARD.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/b8ce234272902f4c9ad26987f9efe86868b49fd3.png

SEASON’S GREETING BOX

Either one of the following items will drop:

TREE SPRAY /3D

notes.content:
Attention Soldiers,

The following features will be implemented on the next patch, November 14th, for Competitive Match - SQUAD

Soldiers can acquire and accumulate the CLAN EXP just as in the CLAN RANKED MATCH.
The CLAN Emblem and CLAN name will be displayed in the UI.

[Competitive Match – SQUAD CLAN EXP & Emblem Event]

Event Period: 2018.11.14 ~ 2018.12.05 

Goal:  All Clan members who have participated the Competitive Match - SQUAD and completed the requirements of the below EVENT1 and EVENT2 (Both Event Clear is possible)

Participate in Competitive Match - SQUAD during the event period and battle to become the TOP 20 CLAN (ACCUMULATED EXP).

Rewards:

Top 10: Clan Emblem and Clan Mark Spray (60 Days) 
Top 20: Clan Emblem:
http://www.blacksquad.com/emblem/


*Notes:

CLAN EXP acquired within a CLAN CHANNEL is not applicable.

Rewards:

All Clans who attain over 100,000 EXP (ACCUMULATED), who participated in Competitive Match - SQUAD during the event period will receive a bonus of 500,000 CLAN EXP.

*Note: CLAN EXP acquired within the CLAN CHANNEL is not applicable.

We look forward to your participation in the upcoming Competitive Match – SQUAD EVENT.

Thank you for playing as always,

-BS Dev Team-.

Surrender Vote Function has been implemented in COMPETITIVE MATCH.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/6506e9a8b95d7c6ebc5b116c1853c46e35a707ba.png

The Surrender Vote Function allows the team to accept to give up the match prior to playing, when it is determined that the team will ‘Lose’.
In order to activate, press ESC and Click on the Surrender Vote UI button, or type '/FF' in Chat Window.
-The Surrender Voting starter is treated as "ACCEPT".
When Voting starts, a system message is displayed on the Chat Window, informing that the Voting has started, and the Surrender UI is displayed on the bottom right of the HUD.
-The system message is displayed only to the team as below format.
-“*** started a Surrender Vote. Surrender is possible only if all soldiers accept. If one soldier rejects, Surrender Vote will be void.”'
Surrender Voting can be done by using the following shortcuts.
-F7 - ACCEPT, F8 - REJECT
-[Note] The 'Friendly IFF ON / OFF' function which was previously assigned to the F8 key has been changed to the '” shortcut key.
The Surrender Vote time is 30 seconds in total, and if the vote is rejected, you can try again 3 minutes later.
-If rejected, the system message “Surrender Vote is over. The match will proceed again according to the result of the voting.”, is displayed in the Chat Window.
-If you start a Surrender Vote again within 3 minutes, the system message “you will not be able to vote again immediately if a Surrender Vote is in progress or it is rejected. Please wait for a while", is displayed in the Chat Window.
-If you do not vote, 'REJECT' will be automatically selected, when voting is ended 30 seconds later.
-If you leave the match during the Surrender Voting, "ACCEPT" is automatically selected.
When the Surrender Vote is activated, soldiers who were not in the match cannot vote.
-Those soldiers are displayed as blank in UI, and the remaining team soldiers are regarded as the maximum voting number.
If a Surrender Vote is done as all agreed, the team will 'Lose'.
If a Surrender Vote has already been activated, another Surrender Vote cannot be activated.

notes.title: Statement about hacks in Black Squad
notes.content:
How to Report Cheat Sites

Basically, there is no way to know if a hack or hack site is working or not without testing it first. However, we went deep undercover and this is what we found:

‘Hack videos’ you may find on YouTube are extremely outdated or re-used as click-bait to increase views.
The majority of free hack sites are fake.
The majority of paid sites are scams. We’ve been getting sent the same hack sites over and over through tickets (Thank you!) But keep in mind that many are already caught by BattlEye, and they keep the site active in order to take your money. The reviews made on their pages are fake and tailored- they delete any negative comments that are made.


As a user you should never try to buy, download, or install any hack. Apart from the fact it’s forbidden by our rules and may lead to a global ban of your account, by downloading a cheat you expose your computer to malware (virus, keyloggers, backdoors, worms, trojans…) that hackers can add to their archives or in their software. They can damage your computer and steal personal information (passwords, files, etc.) In general, beware of anything that asks  - “Please disable your Antivirus before downloading/installing this software”.

Instead, you are highly advised to send us all information, sites, and sources you can find to help us detect the sneakiest cheats and ban users.
To report a hack to us, the easiest way is to send us a ticket using http://support.blacksquad.com

We at Neobricks pay special attention to the tickets sent by players, and we regularly search and check for hacking websites and videos to transmit them to BattlEye. They investigate, test (even paid ones), detect, and ban every user using the hacks.


Hacks Rumors Vs. Facts

Rumor:
BattlEye is outdated! The client files were not updated for months! It can not detect recent hacks anymore!
Fact:
BattlEye client (the software installed on your hard drive) doesn’t have to be updated to detect hacks. Detections are made on the server side, and are updated in real time whenever BattlEye detects a new hack. You will not notice anything on your computer when the anti-cheat updates its database. Client updates only happen to add new features or make fixes to the software itself.


Rumor:
BattlEye doesn’t ban anyone, we never see any message in-game!
Fact:
BattlEye bans players every day- as soon as someone is detected. 
In-game messages do not need to be displayed publicly in lobby or in each game for a ban to be effective.

We’ve decided to add in the first Patch Note of every month the number of accounts banned for the previous month. However, we will NEVER disclose a cheater’s IGN. This is against NeoBricks and Steam’s Code of Conduct.


Rumor:
I reported a player, but the Medics didn’t ban him! They let cheaters play on purpose!
Fact:
Having cheaters in a game is bad for everyone. We do not allow them in-game in any way. But depending on the proofs you send us, one of two things can happen:

The proofs were not enough to show the other player as a cheater. We checked player logs, but it was not suspicious. The player is placed in a watchlist, and if we receive more reports about the same player we will start the next point:
The proofs were enough, his stats were suspicious or the player got reported many times. We send info and proofs to BattlEye for deeper investigation. If BattlEye finds something, the player and everybody using the same hack will be detected and banned. If you want to learn more about how BattlEye works, feel free to read more here: https://www.battleye.com/about/


Rumor:
I saw a player get banned in-game but then returned! Fix your trash BattlEye.
Fact: 
You didn’t see a player get banned, only kicked out. They could have gotten kicked out of the game for other reasons, such as having too high of ping, too many insult reports, disrupting gameplay, AFK, etc.


Rumor:
There is a Trial Version of BattlEye and Black Squad developers don’t pay for all of it.
Fact:
We find this the funniest of all the rumors. There is no such thing as a Trial Version, it does not exist. We pay for BattlEye just like every other game it supports: PUBG, Fortnite, Tom Clancy’s Rainbow Six Siege, Ark, Zula, Arma, etc.


Rumor:
The game is full of cheaters! In every game I am getting one-shotted or taking grenades when i’m hidden!
Fact:
It’s impossible for any hack shield to block every single hack 100%, however we are dedicated to preventing them from spreading in-game.

That being said, Black Squad is a game that may look easy, but still requires a lot of training/experience to really master the game. High skill players trained hard and developed fast reflexes, building up their muscle memory.
There are also a lot of “obvious” spots where people often hide or hold their lines, tricks to learn such as where to jump, where to place the C4, and of course much more. The minimap and game sounds give important information, but some parts of your body may still be visible. Lags can also give you the impression that the player pre-shot you or magically knew your position.

Don’t hesitate to abuse Black Squad’s Practice mode to check how visible you are in some positions, where to throw grenades from “non-obvious” positions, or how to shoot through some objects to common places by using the bots. Players train to find tricks and knowing the maps really well is extremely important!


How to report a hack or a cheater?

Go to http://support.blacksquad.com/ and create an account, if you don’t have one.
Fill out a ticket with all the information you have. Don’t forget to add proofs, links, etc...



What is valid proof?

Sometimes a single screenshot is enough (ie: Scoreboard when a cheater uses some “speedhack” in Destruction mode, the game lasts less than a minute and the full score is made by a single player).

But in most cases, we need real gameplay footage. We often receive small twitch clips of 10 seconds, but it’s not long enough to check if the player didn’t notice you before, what happened before or after the action. The opponent could have heard you, seen you, had a lucky move, etc...
A perfect proof would be at least a full round recorded, ideally, a full match.

We are aware that not everybody can record such proofs, and we will check every report and reported player logs, but we will never directly ban anyone on a single “move”, for example only telling us “that guy is cheating” or a screenshot if it doesn’t show anything.

notes.title: [Dev Announcement: Competitive Match 1st BETA End and 2nd BETA Start]
notes.content:
Hello Soldiers,

This is from the BS Dev Team:


The Competitive Match 1st BETA, which was released on July 26th, has been in service for about a month.

Meanwhile, the BS Dev Team analyzed the statistics based on the collected data and made various modifications and improvements for Competitive Matches.

We would like to thank those of you who have participated in Black Squad during BETA season.


In the upcoming August patch, we will end the 1st BETA and start the 2nd BETA season.

We will try our best to provide you with better service for the 2nd BETA.


When the 2nd BETA season starts, the following changes will be implemented:



All Competitive Match records in progress during the 1st BETA(Trial) season will be reset.

The placement match times required to get Rank(TIER) is adjusted from 10 to 6 times.

There will be greater differences of Rank(TIER) allocation by the result of placement matches.

There will be a greater difference of Win/Loss MMR points, even during a certain period of time after placement matches.

The difference will gradually decrease and stabilize afterwards.

Rewards will be given out when you complete the 6th Competitive Match.

Matchmaking search conditions have improved, so that it can match soldiers faster and quicker in each Rank(Tier)

We fixed the UI to show Rank(Tier) instead of Rank(Account) in Competitive Match.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/b594a5c24e943657f8d3880277d7dda8afa025dc.png

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/5617acc3c12b9de5260b4e32490b24f669108c55.png

The penalty time(BAN TIME) will be applied immediately to any solider who leaves the match, so that the solider cannot join the match again for a certain amount of time.

Changes in Tier Rank : we have added a new Tier Rank: RACCOON Rank. Ranks are adjusted as shown below.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/72c29266405dd1ef6652656bd1d9c257f981c268.png




We will have the 2nd BETA season in Competitive Matches for roughly 2 weeks after the patch update.


We look forward to your high interest and participation once again in the 2nd BETA season.


Thank you always.

-BS Dev Team-

notes.title: Competitive Match Manual
notes.content:
Hello Soldiers,

This is from the BS Dev team.


We have already briefly announced about Competitive Matches from the previous announcement of 'Next Update - Competitive Match'.

Now, we would like to introduce to you more detailed information about Competitive Matches.



* What are the key points of ‘Competitive Matches’?

5 vs 5 Demolition Mode.

The winning team is the first winner of 8th round.

The account rank must be above Sergeant to join.

Only individual soldiers can join this match.



*Where and How can I join in a 'Competitive Match'?

The Competitive Channel is added to all servers. You can join this channel to join in 'Competitive Match'.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/3f312fc3f2884a82abefd444abde320f85f96b78.jpg

You can join a Competitive Match room by clicking the following shown below (Lobby Room -> Match Room).

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/00c82bdc43093a3a2fe6ddf5b5b4f647ff5c0336.jpg
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/3e78461f3d2d8cf647823db8442a7c0a8e9e4b5e.jpg

When it is ready, it will start looking for opponents.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/337f042161502846688840e90538ffa5397f24e8.jpg

5 Friendly members will match with 5 Opponents on fair conditions.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/c177319a4578d02db9d22d12ba4fb694aa3e5c01.jpg

The match starts when all members have completed loading.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/d297e0ad9b917b55d8751a42931df787329dd2d3.jpg

When the match is over. You return to the previous Competitive Match room.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/22e57bd67d58707102acfbc5aa2e5fc20fc3e763.jpg
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/7517c5ded836bacb861f1144cece7efa57540c0e.jpg

 You cannot check your 'Match Making Rate (MMR)' and 'Rank (Tier)' until after the first 10 matches, but you can get MMR Point(s) and Rank(Tier) after completing 10 matches.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/d9e17bcee47de9459bcd975459a2cad3ee708215.jpg
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/3b07228bdee4ad1bd3b4bb0dd942b42172652d0e.jpg
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/806b40b9bb8c75cfa0c36959ee3ef4d8af72bdab.jpg
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/4883c1ba580d52ef114c2e81839afec4f78c7ea8.jpg
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/f68a402bd8bd0a58b89e4474a44b69be7c6f45ce.jpg
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/3e3f4d363659c6f3392b655e7b9376635cda2fad.jpg
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/55eebf9166de7ca691f092a2634a5f9282ec7dd4.jpg
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/fc1ba41cdebba647a757bd991ad6af00c618a5d9.jpg

 MMR Point(s) are increased or decreased, depending on the loss or win by the ELO rating mechanism, and each soldier's MMR point(s) are different, depending on their contribution to victory or defeat.

If two teams with similar skill level join the match, each team will get and lose similar MMR Point.

If two teams with different skill levels join the match, the lower skilled team will receive more MMR Point(s), and the higher skilled team will get fewer MMR Point(s).

The contribution to the match play(Win/Lose) may affect the MMR Point.



*How can I tell by MMR Point(s) and Rank in 'Competitive Match?'

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/be8ef7e04421b3723ee76355d8f7674a822d44bb.png
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/4c8fcaae76f924732078d03e84baa6cfca823adc.png

*How does the Competitive Match operate? 

Since this is the first release of the Competitive Match, we will have a pre-season (trial) for a certain amount of time.

When pre-season ends, we will post a separate announcement for Season 1 starting with the schedule.

When Season 1 ends, we will collect the final Rank of this season through the statistics.

We will announce and give out Season 1 Rewards to the qualified soldiers according to their final rank.

Reward Pool details will be announced later.

 Season 1 becomes the preparation period for Season 2, and Season 2 starts when this period ends.



* What should I pay attention to in Competitive Matches? 

Leaving the match causes a seriously high penalty. However, if you leave the match unexpectedly and want to avoid the penalty, you must return to the match before the match is over.

If you leave the match more than 3 times, you cannot join more Competitive Matches for a certain penalty time. You can join the match again after the penalty time ends.

Our operation team may ban the account for illegal activities, such as leaving the match continuously with intention, severe impoliteness and abusing for the opponents, so that the account cannot join Competitive Match permanently.





Thank you always.

-BS Dev Team-

notes.title: Dev Announcement: Competitive Matches!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/483fdc28851d40ab5b53fcf5f284ca7c183dc111.jpg

Hello Soldiers,

This is from the BS Dev Team:

Competitive Matches will finally be possible in the upcoming patch!

Thank you for patiently waiting for such a long time.

Competitive Matches do not require a clan to join; every soldier can join the match.

Now you must be at your best to compete and win in Competitive Matches, the core purpose of Black Squad is to prove your skills and show you are one of the best players! 

 

What is a Competitive Match?



The Competitive Match is a game mode designed for those who want to seriously test their skills. It is different from quick or custom match, and it is recommended to participate after enough practice.

Competitive Matches start from the pre-season to the regular season. For the first pre-season, everyone will start with the same rank, and the rank system consists of 5 total ranks from the lowest to the highest rank. You must join Competitive Matches to rank up.

Friendly and enemy teaming and match processing is handled fairly using the ELO Rating; all soldiers participating in Competitive Matches will work within this system and its mechanism. Plus, MMR points acquired per user may be different, since the contribution to victory or defeat may be different for each round. It is also applied to Match Making Rate (MMR) Point which is collected every round and finally acquired or lost at the end of the match.

Competitive Matches will not allow mid-match joining, and the penalty for leaving the match is very high. (Sudden disconnections is OK). When one player leaves the game, it creates a huge disadvantage for that team.

Competitive Matches are available from the Sergeant rank (Channel entry requirement)

The Competitive Match is a 5v5 demolition mission and victory is the first winner of the 8th round.

Competitive Matches are only available to join by yourself. (This will be expanded later on to allow for multiple users to join)

 

Skill Rating (MMR Point)



Season 1 starts when the Competitive Match is open after pre-season.

Everyone starts with a basic score for the first time in Season 1, you will be able to see your score and rank from that point. Your win or loss is decided after the first match is over.

Skill ratings increase or decrease, depending on if you win or lose, respectively.

The rate of increase and decrease can vary each game depending on the number of rounds played and your own individual performance and contribution.

The rate is between 0 and 4000. The higher the rate, the better the skill.

Rank changes according to skill rating.

In a Competitive Match, you will be on a team with similar skill ratings; and the opponent team will be matched with similar skill rated soldiers as well.

 

Season System



Competitive Matches are operated as a season system.

The season will last for several months and a specific schedule will be announced later.

Finish the season with good skill ratings by improving your skills as much as possible during the season.

Statistics are reset at the end of the season.

More detailed information will be posted in the upcoming Competitive Match patch notes.

Please get ready for the upcoming Competitive Matches.

Thank you always.

notes.title: Announcement for ‘RE-Skin’ Item
notes.content:
Hello Soldiers,

This is from the BS Dev team:

Our Developer team would like to officially announce and explain the recent controversial issues in our community involving the AK ZHUKOV, SS2V5, Balisong and KATANA.
First of all, we would like to sincerely apologize that those items invoked unnecessary controversial issues at the time of its release.
We deeply ask for your kind understanding about this incident.

We want you to know that the AK ZHUKOV, SS2V5, Balisong items are RE-Skins.
RE-Skin simply means that its function is the same as the original one, and only the Look & Feel(Skin) is designed differently.

For this reason, AK ZHUKOV and SS2V5 belongs to the RE-Skin item group.
Therefore, AK ZHUKOV is the RE-Skin of AK12 and the SS2V5 is the RE-skin of the M4 CUSTOM, and the Balisong is a RE-Skin of other short range melee weapons.


As it is mentioned before, AK ZHUKOV has the 100% same function and features of the AK12 and the SS2V5 has 100% the same functions and features with the M4 CUSTOM.


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/118980712fab8eb863aaa41c4016cc78c658dcd2.jpg



Lastly, the KATANA will also be part of the RE-Skin item group, and our Dev team is currently developing the
same function, but different Look & Feel version of ‘KATANA’ for the ‘MEDAL SHOP' in the future.


Please look forward to it with patience.

As in the past, we are and will be trying our best not to release any P2W items in the future.

Thank you for your kind understanding.
- BS Dev team-

notes.title: Windows 10 - White Screen and Alt+Tab issues fix
notes.content:
Hello Soldiers!
With last Windows 10 Updates, some issues appeared preventing to start the game properly or reducing game performances.
Here are some fix for the White Screen and Alt+Tab issues:



----------
How to fix white screen

#1. Open Steam and go to Black Squad properties
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/4bf4c8ec3a5be98d4f2af998cc581475bdcf6bda.png

#2. Go to the tab called ‘LOCAL FILES’’ and choose ‘BROWSE LOCAL FILES’.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/4bf4c8ec3a5be98d4f2af998cc581475bdcf6bda.png

#3. Go into ‘\binaries\win32’ and find ‘BlackSquadGame.exe’ in explorer, and choose ‘Properties’ using right-click on mouse.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/3527d0efe73f57badd7912a82dc4a0dc27f3d218.png

#4. Go to tab called ‘Compatibility’, and check ‘Disable full screen optimization’.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/a17f40aada5965911ff092e7b7e2ac65e5e28186.png

#5. Run Black Squad and enjoy.



----------
How to fix FPS drops and lags after Alt-Tabbing

#1. Open ‘Settings’
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/20f1db430c5e997baf8066db1cd03995272b5805.png

#2. Search ‘Focus assist settings’ in Windows Settings.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/ecaa8365b92d6e6640a4f42acb6c420adf8df9e3.png

#3. Turn off all options in Focus assist settings.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/7d1cd68d0e95885d8634534f840659a53ff869e9.png

#4. Run Black Squad and enjoy.

How to fix FPS Drops that began AFTER the 25th Patch Update:

1. Update your audio and video drivers.

2. Update DirectX Files.

3. Make sure the FPS Settings in-game is set to unlimited.

If you are still experiencing issues then, please contact the Support Center
http://support.blacksquad.com/ with the following:

1. IGN

2. PC Specs

3. DxDiag files (Run program, save information, and attach the file)

4. Description if you notice there are certain times, behavior, occasions it occurs (like maps, in a match, in lobby, etc.)

----------
We are aware that there are other issues remaining, and the development team will continue working hard to solve them as fast as possible to permit everyone to fully enjoy the game.

Thank you for your patience,
- Your Black Squad Team

notes.title: EA Update 24: Patch Notes
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/5fc2c2fdf143d63d6630a03b9776e295868363cb.jpg

System, Content

Crouch spam prevention system application

The crouch spam prevention system has been applied to all servers/channels.
What is the crouch spam prevention system?
When you crouch continuously several times in a row continuously, crouching speed becomes slower. This system prevents users from having advantages from crouching continuously during combat. When crouching is not used continuously, crouching and standing can be used at normal speed.
Crouch spam prevention system functions. 
Stamina has been added. Crouching requires stamina.
Stamina is not displayed on HUD.
Stamina decreases per crouch.
When crouch is used several times, stamina will decrease. The speed of crouching is direct related with the amount of stamina.
Crouch is available with 100% speed when you have enough stamina.
When there is not enough stamina, the crouching speed will be very slow.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Hello from the Black Squad development team. 

We tested the crouch spam prevention system on the test channel and we received many types of feedbacks from you.
We analyzed the opinions of the players regarding the improvement of some functions and finally applied them as follows. 
The following changes have been made to the crouch spam prevention system that was applied to the test channel.
The stamina recovery speed has been increased. The time required to recover to its maximum has been decreased.
Now you can crouch even if you do not have the minimum stamina required. However the crouch is executed at its slowest speed.
Before, when stamina reached 0, stamina did not start to recover immediately. Now when the stamina reaches 0, the recovery happens immediately. As a result, the time to reach maximum stamina (100) has been decreased. 
Even if you crouch continuously, you can crouch for the first and second time without any speed changes. From the third time on, the user will experience slowness in crouching.
Thank you all for your participation in the last test.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Battle Record Check After Death

Checking each round’s battle record after your character’s death is now available in Demolition and Assassination mode.
Damage you have received, damage to enemies, and kill record is now available.
Battle record will be reset after your character’s death or at the end of the round.
Display battle record when the round ends, in case you are still alive.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/d3729f4190396fd2938bb5859bd622d0fdc0404d.png

Function Improvements
Regardless of right or left hand mode setting, the skills and weapons below will be displayed with right hand mode only.
C4
All the skills except M32, XM25, AT4, STEYR50.
Claymore, Ammo kit, Medi kit, UAV, Sonar Vision, Hell Pike, Sentry Gun, Trophy System, Juggernaut, Artillery support, Heli Support, Air Strike.
The duration for kick AFK(Away from keyboard) has become shorter.
Match room: 5Min → 3Min
In game: 2Min → 1.5Min

Bug Fix
Fixed crosshair alpha value.
Fixed invisible weapon display bug that occurs when swapping weapons while throwing grenade.
Fixed overlap display bug for some Turkish	.
Fixed tool tip display bug for upper, down side icon in lobby.

notes.title: Details on Extended Pre-Season
notes.content:
Soldiers,

As announced in our EA Update 23: Patch Notes, the pre-season has been extended with individual rank points being reset to 3,000.
Here are the details on the extended pre-season.

Period
From April 25 to July 18 (12 weeks in total)
Rewards will be distributed based on the results calculated until July 18. 
The exact date for rewards distribution will be announced later.

Rewards


- 20,000 BS Coin
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/0da68a6fb2ce28f4066d4eef4cfcaec86811d435.png
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/b2a4cdd20758cee4a9a6488e9611d75b6321b2f3.jpg


- 5,000 BS Coin
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/0da68a6fb2ce28f4066d4eef4cfcaec86811d435.png


- 500 BS Coin

How to check your individual rank points

Top 1,000 list can be found on our website - http://blacksquad.com/rank-user/ and are updated at 6AM (UTC) on a daily basis.

- Black Squad Team

notes.title: EA Update 23: Patch Notes
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/065fb258d87bd8f64eadb570a81e6517ef008b85.jpg

System, Content

Clan Rank Match – Pre-Season Extended

Pre-Season Extended.
Individual rank points from Clan rank matches gained during the last Pre-season has been reset.
Individual rank points will be set to 3000.


Hello from the Black Squad development team.
During the pre-season, many clans participated in the clan rank matches. 
We monitored all clan rank matches during the last pre-season; so that we could get meaningful data.
In the extended pre-season, we will use this data to give rewards according to the individual rank points at the end of the season. 
We’ll soon announce the period and standard for rewards.

The following unique item will be included in the rewards.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/0da68a6fb2ce28f4066d4eef4cfcaec86811d435.png
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/b2a4cdd20758cee4a9a6488e9611d75b6321b2f3.jpg

We hope that many of you will participate in the extended pre-season.

Thanks from Black Squad team.

NA, EU Server – Change in the High Ping Check restriction in Clan Channel

Players with a ping higher than 200 are now restricted from playing


Clan Channel–up to master sergeant rank

Clan Channel is available for players with a rank higher than master sergeant.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/26d5a3c68a05e047619cba7c41d4c9dfd6ca0fee.png


Test Channel Removal

All test channels were removed.


Medal Shop

HNK416A5 GL is now on sale.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/2aeaa2955600871da2b72307a6f95d3dd52519c8.png


Function Improvements

Improved FPS drop in-game issue.

Bug Fix

Fixed a display bug that displays word “undefined” on the chat box occasionally.
Fixed an image bug that does not properly reduce its size when the crosshair is set to 0.5 (Image-only issue).

notes.title: [EVENT] Clare Cup - Champions
notes.content:
Hello Soldiers,

The Clare Cup is finally finished, and we would like to thank everyone for participating.
(Special thanks to our Discord moderators who have tremendously helped us in managing the event!)

Now, it’s time to announce the Champions.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/e5569ab4c1e1f45e5f7965912b7559cabf0a8a3d.jpg

The Clare Cup Finals Results

[Europe] iNjection vs 6POINTS
1st: [strike]iNjection[/strike] disqualified 
2nd: 6POINTS
[North America] BlackSquirt vs Bandits
1st: Bandits.
2nd: [strike]BlackSquirt[/strike] disqualified
[South America] RedCompany- vs Method
1st: RedCompany-
2nd: [strike]Method[/strike] disqualified
[Southeast Asia] FPS.GAMING vs -FLY-
1st: -FLY-
2nd: FPS.GAMING
[East Asia] Archer. vs murderer
1st: Archer.
2nd: murderer

iNjection, BlackSquirt and Method are disqualified as one of their players who either played in the Finals or was in the lineup was banned for using hacks. 
As results, these 3 clans cannot receive prizes (including clan marks), and 6POINTS will be the EU champion.

As announced, each player who played at least 1 match in the Finals will receive the following prizes on March 6 (UTC). 
- 1st Clan: exclusive calling card and 25,000 BS Coin
- 2nd Clan: 5,000 BS Coin

The Black Squad Team has thoroughly reviewed every accusation raised during the Finals over the past week.
In order to make the best possible decisions, we have collected the evidence as much as possible, and examined each case from various aspects with care.
If it is found that any other clans did participate in inappropriate ways, they will be punished.

To the top 50 clans, clan marks will be given this week.

GGWP, everyone!

- Black Squad Team

notes.title: EA Patch Note 19
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/0d7aaaee90245eba81171c97ac9ac5e6158faf00.jpg

System & Content

Added test channel

Hello from the Black squad development team.

This patch adds a test channel, and the configuration of the test channel is shown below.

Only players who have the test channel ticket can enter the test channel.
The test channel has a crouch spam prevention system.
The mode/map configuration of the test channel is the same as the custom channel. 
The development team has been monitoring the use of Crouch spam and has come to the conclusion that they should be restricted in continuous use.

The Crouch Spam Prevention System is shown below:

A stamina system has been added, and this stamina is a necessary resource for crouching.
Stamina will be deducted once per crouching.
If the remaining stamina is gradually reduced by using the crouching several times, the crouching/standing speed becomes slower in proportion to the current stamina amount.
If the stamina is at its maximum, the crouching/standing will happen at 100% speed.
If the remaining stamina is insufficient, the speed of crouching/standing will be very slow.
If you do not have enough stamina to do one crouch, you will not be able to crouch. You will need to restore your stamina to a certain amount of time before you can crouch again.
When the stamina reaches zero, it takes about 6 seconds to recover to its maximum value.
Because of the Crouch Spam Prevention System, there is now a limit to the use of Crouching when engaging the enemy, and if used continuously, the Stamina will be depleted quickly and you will not be able to use Crouching until the Stamina is restored. This helps to prevent the Crouch spam.

We hope that the system will have a positive effect. The new system will be applied only to the test channel without applying it to all servers from the beginning. We will receive various opinions from the testers and improve the application timing and system completeness.

The tester selection and the operation plans for the test channel will be announced soon.
We look forward in having a great amount of participation in the test activities, and many feedbacks from players.

Thank you.

Crouch Spam prevention added in practice mode
For test purposes, crouch spam prevention has been added to practice mode.
Lunar New Year Special sale ended
Lunar New Year Special sale has ended.
Korean language support
You can choose Korean language above on the game launcher.
Improvement in Clan Match-Making

Those users whose rank points are too high or low were having trouble in clan match-making,
So we changed the matching system to search for a more wide range of users with faster speed 
Marginal lowest rank points changed from 2500 to 2800
- Rank points lower than 2800 will be changed to 2800.

Medal Shop
SIZ556XI RUS GL is now on sale.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/fc8f7b7cce01f9f8f38ac6c0c91a30faec13197a.png

Function Improvements
Spawn protection will be removed as soon as the protected player do a hostile act. For example, throwing a grenade, attack with a knife or a gun, or using a skill.  
Added weapon FOV option
- Choose FOV value from -5.0 to +5.0. Default FOV is 0.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/5f186f4943aa6c9cf66ab0fdbfb14bed0a30dce3.png
Improved Lobby, In-game chatting display.
- Words in chatting box will no longer be truncated from now on. 
Improved discern system of the tile that the character is stepping on. Now is possible to identify more accurately the character location with the step sound effect. 

Bug
Fixed abnormal grenade display bug in spectator mode.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/5e883b4f2d2a4b414c6dbfb6f8501fdc5df6a614.png
Fixed a bug in game launcher - While in server maintenance, the MAINTENANCE button on launcher will no longer be changed to PLAY button. 
Fixed defuse bug in DUSTSHIELD B site, defusing bomb in B site functions normally now. C4 plant area become little smaller, therefore from now on planting the bomb in the pit is impossible.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/2926bcf96e7daac75c1a13ef4678f0b8d2e1036c.jpg

Because of the Crouch Spam Prevention System, there is now a limit to the use of Crouching when engaging the enemy, and if used continuously, the Stamina will be depleted quickly and you will not be able to use Crouching until the Stamina is restored. This helps to prevent the Crouch spam.

We hope that the system will have a positive effect. The new system will be applied only to the test channel without applying it to all servers from the beginning. We will receive various opinions from the testers and improve the application timing and system completeness.

The tester selection and the operation plans for the test channel will be announced soon.
We look forward in having a great amount of participation in the test activities, and many feedbacks from players.

Thank you.

*Update: -7P.Gamming clan (#23) is disqualified from the Clare Cup for using hack and will not be able to receive a clan mark. As a result, the following clan ranked in 51st will be able to apply for a clan mark.

Hello Soldiers,

First, we’d like to thank you all for playing clan ranked matches over the past 2 weeks.
It is now our pleasure to announce the top 50 clans with highest clan ranked points.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/3e97776d70127954a36a34ab54df834b2139f8a5.png
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/987295e5955a91d8d31219163b935b685f7aaa1f.png

Congratulations to all clans who made it to the top 50!
If your clan is in the top 50 and wish to participate in the Clare Cup, please follow the steps below.

How-To
[olist]
Select a clan representative from among 5 players who will participate in the Semifinal. Clan representatives are in charge of all communication with opposing clans and the Admins (Black Squad Team, Medics, Discord mods) throughout the whole tournament period.
Clan representatives are required to confirm their participation in our Discord(CLARE CUP #confirmation-of-participation) with following information.
- Clan Name
- 2-week Rank

notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/f15fec656476b0c3eea8b5a37feeedcbef69bb50.jpg
*UPDATE: All Semifinal matches should be played in Custom Match Channel.
*UPDATE: Spectator Camera Toggle option should be off.
*UPDATE: All participating clans cannot use a substitute player in the middle of any matches.


Hello Soldiers,

A week has already passed in a flash since the first announcement of the Clare Cup!

On Feb 12, the 2-week clan ranking from 1st to 50th will be announced.
Those clans who enter into the top 40, are expected to confirm their participation in Discord according to the Tournament Schedule below.
As announced earlier, only 4 slots are available for each server region.
1st clan has a priority to choose their tournament server region first, and so on.

Please note that holding multiple tournaments in each server region rather than single tournament is for ping balance between competing clans. 
Thus, it is STRONGLY advised that clans should select the tournament server region with the best ping.

We understand that you all have different opinions about the Clare Cup.
It is worth taking note that the Clare Cup is one of our events to make you keep tac reload.
Especially, it was to boost the Clan Ranked Match this time.
There will be other (and better, for sure) events and tournaments in the future to suit your different needs.
Until then, we really hope you guys enjoy the Clare Cup!


Tournament Schedule

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/9f7098d0c24080541eb2a25787478643c9ebbce5.jpg

 The Tournament Schedule is subject to change, depending on circumstances.


Tournament Rules

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/eeec097448cec0e2c108c72074837da84bc95304.jpghttp://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/18dbc2d191b5354e8fd10d4920648c0ac3a2464f.jpg
Single-elimination tournament with 4 teams in each server region (NA, SA, EU, SEA, EA)
1st clan to choose their tournament server region first, and so on
5 vs 5 Demolition
- No substitue player allowed in the middle of the matches.
Format:
- Semifinal: best of three
- Final: best of five
Channel:
- Semifinal: Custom Match Channel
- Final: Competition Match Channel
Map:
- Semifinal: each clan to choose 1 map
- Final: each clan to choose 2 maps
- Random map for the last match
- A higher ranking clan has a priority to choose the map for the first match. Change the map alternately afterwards.
Team Selection:
- A lower ranking clan has a priority to choose either to attack (Viper Circle) or defend (Peace Maker) for the first match. Change the side alternately afterwards.
Room Conditions:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/e1eff6934d0373c6b28748bdc10f86f453d40c26.jpg

Requirements

General
Every player must understand and agree with the rules in order to participate in the Clare Cup. Also, he or she is expected and required to abide by the rules.
Every participating clan must select a clan representative from among themselves who is in charge of all communication among their clan, opposing clans and the Admins (Black Squad Team, Medics, Discord mods).
Any players who participate in the Clare Cup in inappropriate way will be punished according to our Code of Conduct.
If clan representatives have any issues before, during and after matches, they are required to contact the Admins as soon as possible.
Match Schedule & Results

A clan representative from 1st to 40th clans who wishes to confirm participation is required to post the following in Discord (#confirmation-of-participation) within the Semifinal Scheduling Period:
- Clan Name
- 2-week Rank
- Preferred Region to Play: 1st and 2nd preference
- A screenshot of your clan profile, displaying your Callsign
 If a clan representative DO NOT confirm their participation within the Semifinal Scheduling Period, they CANNOT participate in the tournament. Also, the tournament bracket will be updated in real time during the Semifinal Scheduling Period.
When your tournament bracket is confirmed, the clan representative of higher ranking clan must post the following in Discord (#match-schedule), after discussion with the representative of opposing clan until Feb 15:
- Your clan name vs Opposing clan’s name
- Semifinal match date and time
The Finals Schedule must be discussed with Admins. The relevant announcement will be made before the Final Scheduling Period.
A clan representative of each clan is required to take screenshots of scoreboard after every match. The clan representative of the winning clan must post the screenshots of every scoreboard in Discord (#match-results).

Prizes
1st Clan: exclusive calling card and 25,000 BS Coin
2nd Clan: 5,000 BS Coin
 Only players who play in the Finals are eligible to receive prizes.

notes.title: [EVENT] First Online Clan Tournament - Clare Cup (Updated)
notes.content:
*UPDATE: The clan ranking is based on clan ranked points, NOT clan points. Here is a difference between clan ranked points and clan points - clan ranked points increase AND decrease depending on Clan Ranked Match results, whereas clan points ONLY increase as you play Clan Ranked Match, contributing to your clan level.

*UPDATE: The date of the announcement for the tournament schedules, rules and prizes will be delayed to February 5 from February 2. We apologize for any inconvenience. 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/f15fec656476b0c3eea8b5a37feeedcbef69bb50.jpg

Dear Black Squad Players,

Hello, all Black Squad players out there!

I’m very much excited to announce that...

(DRUM ROLL)

We will be finally having our FIRST EVER online clan tournament, the Clare Cup.

The tournament will be held in each region – EU, NA, SA, EA and SEA servers with the top 4 clans based on clan ranked points. 
The winning clan will be honored with the title ‘Number One Clan in the Region’ and prizes.

Here is how to enter the tournament.

Play as many clan ranked matches as possible for 2 weeks from January 29 to February 11 (UTC).
Become the top 4 clans in the region with highest clan ranked points during this period.


After 2 weeks, the 2-week clan ranking will be announced on February 12. 
We will contact each clan master of top clans to check the intention to participate in the tournament, and the server region via Discord. 
So, to all the clan masters who are thinking to participate, please be ready to talk with us on Discord.

Don’t get disappointed if you think your clan can’t get into the top 4 yet. 
We’re ALSO going to reward the top 50 clans during the period of 2 weeks with clan marks! 
You can see our new selection of about 300 clan marks on our website.

http://blacksquad.com/emblem/

All the details including the tournament schedules, rules and prizes will be announced on [strike]February 2 (UTC)[/strike] February 5.
For those who still do not know where to check the weekly and total clan ranking, check out our website.

http://blacksquad.com/rank-clan/

Until then, spread the words and TAC RELOAD!

- Black Squad Team

notes.title: EA Patch Note 17
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/4e8c07436ccba6e3bd1838ef93c1893e099c264f.jpg

System & Content

Spectator camera first/third person view toggle option for host

Added spectator camera first/third person view toggle option in Demolition, Assassination Mode as host option.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/a8474efe0f23f020f88462ee9d8577f28f64fa62.png
Default value is “off”.
Host can decide On/Off.  In the case that spectator camera option is “ON”, after death, you can observe teammates. You can toggle view to first person or third person by spacebar.
Only available in custom channel.


Real time ping check 

You can check server’s real time ping that you selected in server/channel lobby.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/dbb0d4fc72674b93c6aca56d0310c9e30f647252.png
You can see server’s real time ping that you are joining from the bar that is located upper right corner of the screen.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/8d27d868465878973d1a928ca1200cd8abf40fa8.png


Improved clan information UX

You can see clan information by clicking clan name section in the user’s profile.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/8d35884857c043ab56210defed446ebfce9a18c2.png
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/7fbc476502ec6009410f72053c9a9fdd061be013.png
In clan list, default arrangement of list is “sort by clan rank point”.
Increased the number of matches displayed in clan's Recent Records from 5 to 20. 


New Items

Shop

Battle History Reset Ticket is available now.
- Price: 1,200 Bullet / Permanent.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/30e2c857ce40c6cc51ded96e5cea39ce96cb7271.png
- Battle History Reset Ticket reset the following stats.
- Please be aware that your previous battle history CANNOT be restored after using Battle History Reset Ticket.
*Total  win / lose
*Total  kill / assist / death
*Classic  win / lose
*Classic  kill / assist / death
*Clan  win / lose
*Clan  kill / assist / death
*Number of head shots, fatal shots


Function Improvements

Now you can distinguish between friendly and enemy players while using spectator mode. You can toggle ON/OFF by F8
Yes/no pop-up window will appear for final check when you use call sign change ticket.
Feedback message will appear when your call sign that you want is not available.
- Someone has already using the call sign. 
- Contains unavailable character.
- Contains restricted word.
From now on, personal rank points will remain even if you leave the clan.
If you are not currently in the clan, your personal rank points will be deactivated. It will be displayed as “ - ”. It will activate after joining a clan.
After join a clan, personal rank points will be displayed normally.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/e64bc7ae8a729c0ad32efe60a7d46b090abb971b.png 


Bug

The name card “Happy New Year By .Phz”, its name has corrected.

notes.title: EA Patch Note 16
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/8d86e6968a6715284af1a6b0d2bf32f9b7304e37.jpg

System & Content

Bullet Purchase Pop-up Menu UI Improvement

Improved the design of charge and renew buttons on the Bullet section (below your name card) 
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/7f2ccbceb23ed2557054d509900c860370d55dee.jpg
The Bullet purchase pop-up menu will appear by clicking anywhere on the Bullet section
When Bullet is on sale or special offer, a speech bubble icon will appear on the Bullet section for recognition
- This icon will be automatically off after 1 minute or when clicking charge icon(+) 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/b93c87a4412d14b8ca155f9ee51d9547a9b3f430.jpg

Bullet at Special Price 

Bullet is now on special offer.
- It's one-time-only offer per account
- 1,200 Bullet ($9.99) for only $0.99


Battle B Match Mode & Event Removed

Removed Battle B Match Mode in Quick Match
Removed Happy Holidays & Season’s Greeting mission in Special Event
- Its rewards (Happy Holiday Box) is no longer available as well


Balance

Increased the HP of Heli Support and Minigun’s burst speed for Command Class in Battle mode


New Items

[Medal Shop]

AXMC - new sniper rifle (3,200 Medal / Permanent)
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/6e5e45df5194e3b50e0ee37d222926ebc5bfdbca.jpg


Function Improvement

Improved the stability of ping display on the game launcher
Now you can see real-time ping on the launcher


Bug Fix

You can now change crosshair size for dot and circular type
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/48f34c6f868c766f03a5073c24a3ee8740641e91.jpg
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/bc31f943ef8839828f76cb6fdfec001bef5123bf.jpg
Fixing crosshair option is now available for circular type
Corrected the flag of Georgia on its country name card
[Note] We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience and disappointment caused by this mistake to all Georgian players.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/31be2fd47955b9cd9150434be9755ed0e1bee66e.jpg
Fixed the scoreboard being displayed as 10vs10 mode irregularly in Destruction Mode
Fixed the intermittent bug where Europe server is selected by default on the game launcher
You will receive ‘First day in clan’ Steam Achievement even if you are already in a clan


Localization Fix

[Chinese - Traditional & Simplified]

When you're chatting with someone with Whisper function, their name will no longer be displayed as ‘%name’
When you are in East Asia server, the description of each channel will no longer be displayed as ‘\n’


[Portuguese, French, German, Spanish, Russian]

The weapon description for MP7A1 and KRISS VECTOR will now be fully displayed


[Portuguese, French, German, Spanish]

Corrected the required number of matches to receive rewards from '5/8/10' to ‘1/5/10’ in Daily Mission


[Russian]

Corrected the required number of matches to receive rewards from ‘10’ to ‘6’ in Special Event

notes.title: [EVENT] Happy holiday with Christmas events! (Finished)
notes.content:
Merry Christmas, Soldiers!
The end of the year is coming, and it's time to celebrate and share some events with your friends!


Event 1 - Who makes Santa angry?

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/9dfe1d39ae5a3a62b13c038a7984fc885d708752.jpg

Now it is Bed Time and good children should be sleeping, so that Santa can deliver presents to everyone. But this year, many didn't want to sleep so that they can play Black Squad, and this is making Santa really angry!
Nothing could please the Grinch more, who decided to reward the naughtiest ones!


Event Time: From 20th December (After the update) ~ 27th December 23:59 (CET)
How to participate: Play as much as possible during this period on Cream Cake map (Quick Match only) and receive a present according to the time passed in games. 
Please note that only completed matches will be counted!
Rewards: 
- 1st Place: 3000 BS Coins
- 2nd Place: 2500 BS Coins
- 3rd Place: 2000 BS Coins
- 4th Place: 1500 BS Coins
- 5th Place: 1000 BS Coins
- 6th~10th Place: 800 BS Coins
- 11th~50th Place: 600 BS Coins
- 51st~100th Place: 400 BS Coins
- 101st~1000th Place: 200 BS Coins


Event 2 - Christmas Clan Portrait

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/e4e7e751d6fbfea9d11ce67982873a68a2118853.jpg

It's a tradition for some, a pain for others, Christmas is the perfect time to take a Family Portrait.
Share a screenshot with your clanmates at your favorite festive spot in Cream Cake map and win Presents!


Event Time: From 20th December (After the update) ~ 27th December 23:59 (CET)
How to participate:
- Bring your Clan mates to Cream Cake (Battle B ~ Quick Match)
- Take a beautiful screenshot with them
- Post the screenshot on our Discord 'Christmas clan portrait' channel with the in-game names of every participant ("photographer" included) and the Clan Name to have a chance to win BS Coins!
Rewards:
- Every Player shown in the screenshot (plus photographer) will be rewarded 500 BS Coins for their efforts.
- At the end of the event, 5 screenshots will be picked by the Medic team. For the clans that win: 50,000 Gold and 500 BS Coins will be awarded to the entire clans' members.
Note:
-The clan name must appear in the screenshot (the photograph must aim one team member)

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/c5cb9f626b0d12d8b3405db1fd60f3e9c80aef56.png

-Do not forget to add all in-game names of the players in the photo in the description.


Event 3 - Christmas Wishlist

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/723b8d4d5b9687141443f9c9d79a2c5d26d0712b.jpg

Ho Ho Ho ! Hello little Friend, Come here and tell me, what would you like for Christmas?
But beware! I'll only give the reward to 5 players who voted for the most chosen gift!


Event Time: From 20th December (After the update) ~ 25th December 23:59 (CET)
How to participate: Tell us what reward you would like to receive by using an emote on this Facebook post and by commenting your Ingame Nickname in comments
Rewards: 5 players will receive the most chosen one between
- 100,000 Gold
- 1500 Medals
- Christmas Grenade (30 Days)
- Cheryl (30 Days)
- 1 Winter Random Box


We hope you'll enjoy these events and have a wonderful Christmas with your friends and family!
Stay warm, eat a lot, and enjoy Black Squad!



Your Black Squad Medic Team
