notes.title: We announce our new code of conduct !
notes.content:
Hello Soldiers!

We would like to announce our new Punishment Policy that will be applied 
from the 20th of December 2017.

We do not especially like doing this, but it has become necessary to create some rules in order to ensure a fun and safe environment for everyone. 
The following Policy is given as an example, and specific cases will be investigated separately.

The Black Squad team reserves the right to apply sanctions to cases not defined in this list when necessary.


Communication
When participating in communication, you are responsible for how you express yourself. You may not use language that could be offensive or vulgar to others.

Hate speech and discriminatory language is inappropriate, as is any obscene or disruptive language. 
Threatening or harassing another player is always unacceptable, regardless of language used. 
Violating any of these expectations will result in a temporary account ban. More serious and repeated violations will result in greater punishments.

Naming
Any name the player has the ability to customize —such as Name Tags, or Clan Name—must be appropriate and inoffensive. Any name that violates our standards or disrupts the community will have to be changed as soon as possible or it may result in an account ban.

Take note that acceptable names are determined by player reports and Medics’ decision.

Cheating
You are responsible for how you and your account are represented in the game world. Cheating in any fashion will result in immediate action. Using third-party programs to automate any facet of the game, exploiting bugs, or engaging in any activity that grants an unfair advantage is considered cheating as well as hacking and could lead to a lifetime ban of the account.

Exploiting other players is an equally serious offense. Account sharing, win-trading, and anything else that creates an unfair gaming experience for other players will receive harsh penalties such as an account reset or ban. This will be applied to Players as well as to clans.
Please note that if your clan is caught cheating in any way (using hack, boosting, or anything else), your clan will become ineligible for all further rewards from events.

Behavior
Behavior that intentionally detracts from others' enjoyment (such as being AFK, blocking, etc.) is unacceptable. We expect our players to treat each other with respect and promote an enjoyable environment. Acceptable behavior is determined by player reports and Medics’ decision, and violating these guidelines will result in account restrictions.


If you encounter players misbehaving, we encourage you to send us a report containing proof such as screenshots or videos here: http://support.blacksquad.com
So we can act against violators as soon as possible.

Please note that this Policy is not retroactive and will concern new violations that will happen after the 20th of December.


Let’s play fair and enjoy Black Squad together!



Your Black Squad Medic Team

New Year is just around the corner!
To celebrate this coming 2018, we will hold a calling card creation contest.
1st place winner’s calling card will be given to all users.

Submit your own calling card design with your signature on it in Discord’s “Calling Card Event” channel

SYSTEM, CONTENT
[Clan Ranked Match]

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/48a8dfac75be263329eb688778d934343c639fc8.png

Newly added Clan Ranked Match is still a beta version, and can be run temporarily to verify various systems and content to be added in the future
Rank point increase and decreases depending on the match results
Range of increase and decrease of point will be judged as relative superiority, equality, and relative disadvantage depending on clan’s current rank point
Clan Ranked Match is only playable for premade 5-players team with at leat 3 or more players of the same clan
Default ranked point is as below
 - Player: 3,000 point
 - Clan: 15,000 point
 - Player rank point won’t drop below 2,800 points
Due to the addition of Clan Ranked Match, the existing clan match will be removed

notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/0cf12a56982d3d6b63e75b1b91f8a4379220aad8.jpg

System, Content
 
[Zoom Sensitivity Option]
- Players will now be able to adjust zoom sensitivity of each pre-set
- Mouse sensitivity and each of pre-set’s zoom sensitivity can be adjustable in 
  “Option-> Control -> Mouse settings”
  * Default setting is 5.0
  * If you check “ALL” then it will act as a master sensitivity and be applied to all three pre-set’s
  * You can control the sensitivity by pressing [ and ] button 

(upon testing, we found a bug in zoom sensitivity which you can set your sensitivity 10 as a maximum sensiivity. This bug will be fixed on next week's patch)

- Quick match balance divided into two levels; 
   * Enlisted level only

   * Officer rank with below 1.2 KAD
   * Officer rank with and above 1.2 KAD
 
[BOT TDM PASSWORD SETTING]
- Players can now set a password when creating a BOT TDM room in a Custom Math Channel

notes.title: Closed Beta Test Announcement: error guideline
notes.content:
Dear Players,

1. To those who are getting an error please close the error pop up and try to connect to Black Squad again. 

2. To those who are stuck in black screen, please wait for a while to connect to our server. It may take few minutes.

3. If you are getting an memory loss error, please try to reconnect. if it doens't work. try to delete the client and reinstall the game.

4. If you are getting a connection error "input username and password" please restart Steam and try to reconnect Black Squad

5. If you are getting an "Exception Processing Message" error, please download and install vcredist in following website and run the client again 

https://www.microsoft.com/en-au/download/confirmation.aspx?id=30679


 -From Black Squad Team
